title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst – Fintech Consulting Engagement (Remote | Brazil) 300 Software | Full-time Consulting Role
description:
About the Engagement

300 Software is expanding its presence in the US fintech market through a strategic consulting partnership with an online consumer lending company that provides lines of credit of up to $2,000 to everyday Americans for essential needs like medical, home repair, and unexpected expenses. They serve a broad, non-prime consumer segment, making real credit decisions in under 3 seconds in a data-heavy, high-volume environment where credit model performance directly impacts business outcomes.

This engagement is part of 300 Software's growing fintech practice, where we embed analytical and engineering talent within client operations — bringing Brazilian technical expertise to US financial services companies. The relationship has strong potential to evolve beyond analytics into tool development and deeper platform work.


The Role

As a Senior Credit Risk Analyst, you'll work as part of the 300 Software consulting team embedded with the client. This role sits at the intersection of data science, statistical modeling, and credit strategy — with direct visibility to executive leadership and real business impact from day one.

Your core mission is to identify issues inside credit models, analyze loan performance data, and help the team understand whether models are performing in line with expectations — and drive the changes when they're not.


What You'll Do

Monitor and analyze credit model performance, comparing actual loan behavior against model assumptions. Use regression analysis and other statistical and predictive tools to surface insights from performance data. Write complex SQL queries to extract and analyze data from cloud-based data lakes in an AWS environment. Build dashboards and reporting tools to communicate credit risk trends to leadership. Help define which borrower attributes to track and weight in underwriting decisions. Participate in weekly reporting meetings with the US-based team (Central Time Zone, 2 to 3 hour difference from Brazil). Collaborate with engineering and compliance teams to implement credit strategy improvements. Work alongside 300 Software's internal data and infrastructure team, which supports the client's AWS environment and data layer.


What We're Looking For

5 or more years of experience in credit analysis, data analytics, or a related quantitative role. Strong SQL skills including complex queries, data extraction, and reporting. Solid understanding of statistical modeling including regression analysis, predictive modeling, and scorecard development. Experience working with data lakes and cloud environments, with AWS being a plus. Comfort operating independently in a remote setup. Fluent English, as you will be in meetings and communicating directly with the US team. A background in engineering, statistics, or mathematics is a strong plus.


Setup

Remote from Brazil, full-time, 40 hours per week, with hours aligned to US Central Time Monday through Friday. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. Contract or PJ arrangements can be discussed.


Why This Role

This is not a typical outsourcing position. You'll be joining a consulting firm that is actively building its fintech practice in the US market, with a client relationship that is expected to grow. Strong performance here opens doors to broader product and tool development work as the engagement evolves.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.


This role involves close work with low-level system internals, performance instrumentation, and automated test development.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance the PMC validation test suite on FreeBSD for modern platforms
  • Validate core, uncore, and IBS performance monitoring counters
  • Validate PMC multiplexing on FreeBSD
  • Validate proper PMC attach functionality to existing processes
  • Design and automate test scenarios across various performance monitoring frameworks
  • Collaborate with kernel engineers to analyze results, identify issues, and propose fixes or improvements
  • Maintain documentation, test plans, and validation reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks and test coverage


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)
  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware
  • Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)
  • Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks
  • Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Mendix Sênior Web - Full Remoto
description:
Oportunidade: Desenvolvedor(a) Mendix Sênior – Soluções Financeiras e Cartões


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Mendix com perfil técnico sólido para atuar em um dos principais players de soluções financeiras e administração de cartões de crédito do país, especializado no setor varejista.


Você integrará uma squad estratégica focada no novo motor de processamento de faturas (projeto já em produção). O desafio envolve lidar com regras de negócio críticas, como processamento de corte, encargos, consolidação de informações e transição de sistemas legados, em um ecossistema que integra Mendix , Golang e APIs de alta performance.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Modelagem de Domínio: Criar e gerenciar entidades, associações e atributos complexos no modelo de domínio.
  • Lógica e Fluxos: Desenvolver microflows e nanoflows robustos para lógica de negócios e interações de usuário.
  • Arquitetura e Decisões Técnicas: Definir arquitetura da aplicação (monolito x modular), separação por domínios e tomar decisões de trade-off entre performance, sustentação e prazo.
  • Padronização: Criar e seguir padrões de projeto para microflows, naming, segurança e páginas.
  • Integrações e Performance: Integrar com APIs externas e serviços web, além de antecipar problemas de escalabilidade e otimizar o desempenho do sistema para grandes volumes de transações.
  • Qualidade: Depurar aplicações e criar testes automatizados para garantir a estabilidade do código em produção.
  • Documentação: Manter a documentação técnica clara e concisa para a evolução do sistema.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicações com a plataforma Mendix .
  • Conhecimento em configuração de segurança de aplicação (regras de acesso e permissões).
  • Vivência em processos de Deploy e gerenciamento de versões.
  • Experiência em squads que utilizam metodologias ágeis (Jira/Confluence ).


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento no mercado de cartões de crédito e meios de pagamento .
  • Vivência em projetos que envolvam convivência entre Mendix e linguagens de backend (ex: Golang).


Detalhes da Oportunidade:

  • Modelo de Contratação: PJ (180h/mês).
  • Nível de Experiência: Pleno em transição para Sênior.
  • CNAE aceito: 62.01-5-01 (Desenvolvimento de programas de computador sob encomenda).
  • Local de Trabalho: Remoto (com idas ao escritório apenas sob demanda/combinado).


Benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (SulAmérica)
  • Gympass
  • Adicional Anual (conforme política interna)
  • 8 dias úteis de recesso remunerado

title: Email & Retention Marketer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,000 - $1,400 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a data-driven Part-Time Email Marketer  to own the end-to-end retention strategy for two sister companies: a visual, custom-framing e-commerce site and a B2B wholesale moulding supplier.


You will be responsible for turning one-time buyers into repeat customers (D2C) and nurturing long-term professional relationships with artists, photographers, and businesses (B2B).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lifecycle Strategy:  Audit and rebuild automated \"flows\" for both brands (Welcome Series, Abandoned Cart, Win-back, and Post-Purchase).
  • Segmentation:  Create distinct \"Pro\" vs. \"Consumer\" segments to ensure B2B leads (photographers/galleries) receive different messaging than one-off home decor customers.
  • Campaign Management:  Manage the weekly calendar for both brands, including promotional campaigns for the e-commerce brand and industry-specific insights and nurture content for the wholesale business.
  • A/B Testing:  Constantly experiment with subject lines, send times, and CTA layouts to optimize Open Rates and Click-Through Rates.
  • Performance Reporting:  Track and report on Email-Attributed Revenue and List Growth monthly.


Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Platform Expertise:  3+ years of advanced proficiency in e-commerce email marketing platforms is a must.
  • Copywriting:  Ability to toggle between \"Inspiring & Aesthetic\" (D2C) and \"Professional & Direct\" (B2B).
  • Design Lite:  Proficiency with visual design tools to create or edit email templates that align with the brand identity.
  • B2B Experience:  Experience with \"Sales Enablement\" style emails (plain-text, personal feel) meant to drive inquiries for high-volume wholesale orders.
  • Data Literacy:  Deep understanding of how to use email data to inform the wider growth strategy.


Bonus Points:

  • Experience in the home decor, photography, or art industries.
  • Understanding of SMS marketing integration.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive retention and growth strategies for a fast-evolving e-commerce and wholesale business.


Commitment: Part-Time (around 10-15 hours a week), Long-term, Overlapping with PST working hours.


*Please note our partner is only looking for dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenação do Departamento de Marketing compreendendo Trade, Comunicação, CRM e Programa de Benefícios;
  • Planejamento do calendário anual de campanhas e eventos e elaboração de plano de marketing com o orçamento de despesas de sua área;
  • Controle financeiro;
  • Negociação com parceiros e patrocínios;
  • Interface com agência de publicidade e promoção: elaboração de briefings de campanhas, plano de mídia, comunicação interna do shopping, campanhas promocionais (mecânica, documentação, premiação, prestação de contas);
  • Responsável pela comunicação do shopping com a assessoria de imprensa: aprovação de releases e sugestão de pautas;
  • Preservar a imagem do empreendimento junto ao público em geral e lojistas;
  • Contribuir com a Gerência de Marketing, participando de reuniões sistemáticas com a equipe para avaliação de metas setoriais, acompanhamento dos indicadores de qualidade, desenvolvimento de planos de melhoria contínua e intercâmbio de informações.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e áreas correlatas;
  • Diferenciais: MBA em administração, comunicação, marketing, produção de eventos.
  • Pacote Office Avançado;

O Que Temos Para Você

  • Experiência com integração de serviços e APIs externas.
  • Conhecimento em Git e boas práticas de versionamento de código.
  • Experiência com SQL Server , incluindo modelagem relacional e construção de queries.
  • Experiência sólida com JavaScript e desenvolvimento de aplicações web.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks ou bibliotecas modernas (Vue, React, Angular ou similares ).
  • Aplicação de boas práticas no desenvolvimento de interfaces, componentização e consumo de APIs.
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis, como Scrum, Kanban ou similares.


Diferencias (Não eliminatório):

  • Experiência com testes automatizados (front-end e back-end).
  • Conhecimento em mensageria e integrações assíncronas.
  • Vivência com containers e ambientes em cloud.
  • Experiência atuando como referência técnica ou apoiando o desenvolvimento de outros profissionais.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados em grafo (Neo4j).
  • Experiência com MongoDB, incluindo modelagem e consultas.


Soft Skills:

  • Perfil sênior, com autonomia, responsabilidade e visão sistêmica.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e foco na resolução de problemas.
  • Comunicação clara e habilidade de colaboração com diferentes áreas.
  • Comprometimento com qualidade, prazos e melhoria contínua.
  • Visão orientada ao impacto das soluções no negócio e perfil curioso, com interesse constante em aprender e evoluir.


Atividades:

  • Desenvolver e manter soluções Full Stack, atuando no back-end e front-end das aplicações.
  • Criar e evoluir APIs RESTful utilizando Node.js e JavaScript, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura.
  • Desenvolver interfaces e componentes de front-end, garantindo usabilidade, performance e boa experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de novos projetos e na manutenção corretiva e evolutiva de sistemas existentes.
  • Realizar integrações com serviços internos e APIs de terceiros, assegurando confiabilidade e segurança.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis (planejamento, refinamento, reviews e retrospectivas).
  • Aplicar boas práticas de engenharia de software, como DDD, versionamento de código, revisão de código e padronização.
  • Contribuir para decisões técnicas e evolução da arquitetura das soluções.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times de Produto, Negócio, Qualidade, Infraestrutura e Segurança.
  • Garantir que as entregas estejam em conformidade com os padrões de qualidade, segurança e governança da empresa.

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Especialista Inteligencia Artificial
description:
Especialista Inteligencia Artificial


Modalidade PJ - Contrato Prazo Indeterminado

Modelo: Remoto Full


Projeto: Sustentação


Descrição Detalhada:

- Profissional especialista encarregado de liderar o design, desenvolvimento e otimização dos sistemas de IA que são o cérebro do assistente de cartões.

- Este desenvolvedor irá projetar e implementar agentes autônomos e fluxos de interação complexos, com foco especial na integração e orquestração de Modelos de Linguagem Grandes (LLM).

- Espera-se que atue como uma referência técnica, definindo boas práticas e garantindo a performance e escalabilidade das soluções de IA.


Habilidades e Conhecimentos Necessários:

- Frameworks de Agentes: Proficiência avançada em LangChain/LangGraph para construção de agentes complexos e cadeias de prompts.LLMs e NLP

- Profundo conhecimento em LLMs, Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), técnicas de fine-tuning e estratégias de otimização de prompts (prompt engineering).

- Programação: Domínio de Python e suas principais bibliotecas de IA (ex: Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch).

- Integração e APIs: Vasta experiência na construção e consumo de APIs REST para integrar o agente com múltiplos sistemas, seguindo o padrão MCP.

- Infraestrutura de IA: Familiaridade com MLOps, contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes) e ambientes de nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).

description:

Não precisa de experiência em finanças. Precisa ter relacionamento com pessoas investidoras.

Se você é corretor de alto padrão, assessor, empresário com rede sólida ou simplesmente conhece as pessoas certas — me chama no privado.

Envie mensagem com \"CAMBORIÚ\" para eu te passar os detalhes.

Vagas limitadas — trabalho com poucos parceiros, mas os certos.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas Pleno
description:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Suporte a Sistemas Pleno para atuar no atendimento e resolução de incidentes em sistemas internos.   • Capacidade de análise inicial de incidentes e troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento intermediário em PostgreSQL (queries, análise de logs e troubleshooting)
  • Conhecimento em SQL
  • Capacidade de leitura e análise de código para identificação de problemas


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em IDE Visual Studio
  • Noções de desenvolvimento em .NET
  • Experiência com sistemas internos corporativos
  • Familiaridade com processos de sustentação (suporte corretivo e evolutivo)

description:
Banco de Talentos | QA Automação


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de QA com foco em Automação de Testes, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua dos processos de testes.


Se você busca atuar em ambientes modernos de engenharia, com forte cultura de qualidade e automação, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir automações de testes (funcionais, integração, regressão, etc.);
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de testes automatizados;
  • Atuar na garantia de qualidade em aplicações web, APIs e, em alguns casos, mobile;
  • Integrar testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento para garantir entregas de alta qualidade;
  • Identificar riscos, gaps de cobertura e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Contribuir com a evolução das práticas de qualidade e engenharia de testes;
  • Participar de code reviews e disseminar boas práticas de testes.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com automação de testes (web, APIs e/ou mobile);
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python ou similares;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com testes de APIs (Postman, RestAssured ou similares);
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de testes (pirâmide de testes, testes unitários, integração, E2E);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência com automação de testes mobile (ex: Appium) será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em testes de performance e/ou segurança é um diferencial;
  • Certificações em qualidade de software (como ISTQB) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Olhar crítico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Pensamento analítico e foco em qualidade;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Curiosidade e interesse por novas ferramentas e práticas de testes;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho.

title: Clinical Data Analyst
description:
Salary: 15hr - 22hr USD


Job description: We are seeking a detail-oriented Tester/Systems Analyst to join the Global Clinical IT team for one of our medical device clients. This role requires a detail-oriented Tester / Systems Analyst to join the Global Clinical IT team supporting a leading medical device client. This role focuses on mapping clinical trial data from source systems to target platforms, defining transformation rules to align data with the target data model, and validating data accuracy through comprehensive testing. The ideal candidate brings strong experience working with Oracle databases, Tableau reporting, and end-to-end data pipelines (including ingestion, transformation, monitoring, and validation). This position is heavily focused on data mapping and testing, with minimal involvement in requirements gathering.


Must haves:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 4+ years of experience in a QA/Tester or Data Analyst role with a strong data mapping focus
  • 4+ years of experience with clinical trial databases
  • Hands-on experience validating data mapping and transformation
  • Strong SQL skills for querying and validating data
  • Experience testing Tableau dashboards for data accuracy and visual integrity
  • Understanding of ETL tools and cloud environments (e.g., AWS S3, Athena)
  • Attention to detail, analytical mindset, and ability to work independently
  • Strong communication skills to interface with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Plusses:

  • Experience in medical devices, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industries

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred

title: SAP Basis / Technical Analyst (Archiving & Support)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender um cliente global do segmento de energia, com forte atuação em projetos de tecnologia e inovação, inserido em um ambiente corporativo robusto, com operações críticas e times distribuídos globalmente. O projeto envolve sustentação e evolução de soluções SAP voltadas à gestão e arquivamento de dados, com alta exigência em performance, disponibilidade e governança da informação.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar com arquivamento de dados e documentos em SAP (ADK/AIS), incluindo execução e recuperação (PrintList, Inbound e Outbound)
  • Configurar e manter Archive InfoStructures (AIS), incluindo catálogo de campos, build/load/unload
  • Tratar falhas em jobs de arquivamento e otimizar processos de execução
  • Atuar com suporte L2/L3 em incidentes e problemas relacionados às soluções de arquivamento SAP
  • Monitorar ambiente (Datadog, scripts PowerShell), garantindo saúde, disponibilidade e performance
  • Acompanhar capacidade do ambiente (CPU, memória, disco, spool) e atuar na resolução de gargalos
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura (atualizações de aplicação, banco, sistema operacional e hardware)
  • Gerar relatórios e indicadores (KPIs) para stakeholders
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada e propor melhorias e automações
  • Atuar em conjunto com times globais na restauração de serviços e troubleshooting

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com SAP Archiving (ADK e AIS)
  • Vivência com objetos de arquivamento (FI_DOCUMNT, SD_VBAK, CO_ITEM, entre outros)
  • Experiência com suporte L2/L3 (incident e problem management)
  • Conhecimento em administração básica de Windows Server
  • Experiência com monitoramento e automação (ex: Datadog, PowerShell)
  • Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting, análise de logs e performance
  • Experiência com jobs de housekeeping e data archiving
  • Inglês avançado para atuação em ambiente global

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimentos em SAP ILM (Retention Management e Retention Warehouse)
  • Noções de ABAP para suporte e ajustes em rotinas de arquivamento
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps e ServiceNow
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e com boa comunicação

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: CX Designer
description:
Buscamos um(a) CX Designer com sólida experiência em gestão e aprimoramento da experiência do cliente, capaz de analisar jornadas complexas, identificar oportunidades estratégicas e propor soluções que elevem a percepção de valor da marca. O(a) profissional atuará de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas, garantindo coerência, qualidade e eficiência em todas as interações ao longo da jornada do cliente. Procuramos alguém analítico(a), organizado(a) e orientado(a) a resultados, com foco na tomada de decisão baseada em dados e na melhoria contínua.



Responsabilidades :


  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar jornadas do cliente, identificando pontos críticos, melhorias e oportunidades de inovação;
  • Conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas para obtenção de insights sobre comportamentos, necessidades e expectativas dos clientes;
  • Desenvolver e manter artefatos de CX, como personas, mapas de empatia, blueprints de serviço e fluxos de interação;
  • Colaborar com áreas internas (Produto, Marketing, Atendimento, Operações e Tecnologia) para garantir consistência e excelência na experiência do cliente;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Voice of Customer (VoC), incluindo análise de NPS, CSAT, CES e demais indicadores estratégicos;
  • Facilitar workshops, sessões de co-criação e dinâmicas de alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Propor soluções orientadas por dados, visando satisfação, retenção e fidelização.


Requisitos:


Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência prévia como CX Designer, Service Designer, UX Researcher ou funções correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de Design Thinking, Service Design e técnicas de pesquisa com usuários;
  • Habilidade em estruturar informações, traduzir insights em ações práticas e construir jornadas complexas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar análises e recomendações;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado à melhoria contínua.


Desejáveis:


  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Miro, Figma, Notion, Jira ou equivalentes;
  • Conhecimento de métricas de experiência (NPS, CSAT, CES);
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

title: Advogado(a) Pleno | Contencioso Cível
description:
Aqui, você não é apenas um número. Você é protagonista.


Atribuímos à lealdade e à parceria os nossos valores mais intrínsecos. Estamos de peito aberto para escutar e construir um resultado coletivo, integrado entre os nossos profissionais e os nossos clientes.


Somos um escritório de advocacia preparado para entender, no detalhe, as necessidades de cada caso, comunicando-se sempre da forma mais clara e inteligível.


Como um escritório abrangente e altamente qualificado , proporcionamos soluções jurídico estratégicas por meio de uma equipe experiente e informada, movida pela atitude de facilitar as vias das soluções jurídicas, com base em informações completas e seguras das tradicionais até as mais inovadoras.


Queremos e conseguimos ser uma extensão estratégica dos nossos clientes, oferecendo as soluções eficientes e duradouras, adaptadas para cada individualidade.


Juntos, nós seguimos na direção de um caminho justo e coerente.


Cargo: Advogado(a) Pleno em Contencioso Cível


Missão do Cargo:

Atuar em casos litigiosos de forma técnica e eficiente, garantindo que os clientes recebam orientação jurídica clara e suporte confiável, contribuindo para a solução dos processos e para a estratégia do escritório.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Atuação em casos litigiosos no geral, com exposição a diferentes áreas do contencioso, incluindo família e sucessões.
  • Reuniões com clientes para esclarecimento de dúvidas e alinhamento de estratégias.
  • Elaboração de peças processuais e acompanhamento do andamento dos processos, garantindo qualidade técnica e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Diligências presenciais e levantamento de informações junto a órgãos públicos e tribunais.
  • Suporte à equipe na análise de casos e preparação de documentos jurídicos, mantendo comunicação clara com clientes e colegas.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Direito (registro ativo na OAB).
  • Experiência prévia em contencioso cível.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento com clientes.
  • Organização, comprometimento com prazos e atenção a detalhes.
  • Desejável experiência em família e sucessões.


Benefícios:


  • Salário competitivo;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Reembolso de atividade física;
  • Estacionamento ou auxílio mobilidade;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento;
  • Bônus.


Regime de Trabalho

  • Modelo híbrido: 4 dias presenciais e 1 dia remoto .

title: Representante Comercial Externo - Empilhadeira
description:
Buscamos talentos com experiência em venda de Empilhadeiras;


Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção e desenvolvimento de clientes e mercado;
  • Atualização e interação com CRM (gestão de clientes e projetos);
  • Elaboração de análises, comparativos e apresentações técnicas sobre equipamentos;
  • Elaboração de propostas e contratos e acompanhamento das fases do projeto até entrega dos equipamentos;
  • Atender e visitar os clientes, elaborar propostas, negociar, preencher contratos e acompanhar todas as fases da venda;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho e a aceitação dos produtos vendidos em conjunto com o time de Pós-Vendas.


Qualificações

  • Bons conhecimentos em Informática;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Experiência com ERPs;
  • Necessário experiência com vendas de Empilhadeiras).

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce Sênior
description:
Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor Salesforce Sênior com experiência aprofundada em Salesforce Health Cloud para atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de nossas soluções internas. Este profissional será peça-chave na implementação de melhorias, integrações e novos componentes, garantindo alta qualidade técnica e contribuindo para a transformação digital da empresa.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Desenvolver e manter soluções na plataforma Salesforce com foco em Health Cloud;
  • Criar e personalizar componentes utilizando Apex , Lightning Web Components (LWC) , Visualforce e demais tecnologias do ecossistema Salesforce;
  • Projetar e implementar integrações entre o Salesforce Health Cloud e outros sistemas, utilizando APIs , Web Services e middleware ;
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas escaláveis;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código seguindo melhores práticas, incluindo testes automatizados e revisões de código;
  • Participar do processo de deploy , versionamento e do ciclo de vida das aplicações Salesforce;
  • Oferecer suporte técnico e treinamento para usuários e stakeholders internos quando necessário.


Requisitos e Qualificações:


  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento Salesforce, com foco no módulo Health Cloud ;
  • Domínio de Apex , Lightning Web Components (LWC) , Visualforce e SOQL ;
  • Conhecimento em integrações com APIs REST/SOAP e middleware como Mulesoft , Dell Boomi ou similares;
  • Experiência com Git , CI/CD e ferramentas de versionamento;
  • Certificações Salesforce relevantes (Salesforce Certified Health Cloud Consultant, Salesforce Platform Developer I/II são diferenciais);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares;
  • Habilidade para traduzir requisitos técnicos e de negócio de maneira clara.


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência no setor de saúde e entendimento dos fluxos de trabalho da área;
  • Conhecimento em segurança e compliance para dados de saúde (HIPAA, LGPD, entre outros);
  • Familiaridade com Einstein Analytics e outras ferramentas de análise de dados Salesforce.

title: Senior NOC engineer (Network engineer)
description:
Join our fast-growing company as an Senior NOC engineer (Network engineer) with C1 level of English language.


It is a remote full-time position.


Schedule: Mon-Fri; 9am-6pm, CET

Starting date:


At Mindy Support you have great opportunity to get:


  • Experience in the international company working with people around the globe;
  • Compensation - $950 (during 2 months of probation period), $1050 + $50 monthly bonus based on KPI after probation
  • Training will be provided by the company and the client;
  • Dynamic work in a young team of like-minded people;
  • Management's attention, support and motivation.




Key Responsibilities:

● Technical Operations: Monitor and manage SD-WAN

connections (Cato, Cisco Meraki) and DIA circuits, ensuring

optimal performance and availability. Act as the escalation point

for complex NOC issues, providing advanced troubleshooting and

resolution. Collaborate with ISPs, vendors, and internal teams to

resolve outages and performance issues in a timely manner.

Support proactive network health monitoring, capacity planning,

and performance tuning. Manage configuration, deployment, and

maintenance of SD-WAN devices and edge routers.

● Leadership & Coordination: Serve as the right hand to the NOC

Team Lead, assisting in team oversight and daily operational

activities. Provide mentorship and training to junior NOC

engineers, improving overall team capabilities. Help coordinate

shift handovers, incident escalations, and service restoration

activities. Contribute to onboarding documentation, runbooks, and

troubleshooting guides.

● Incident Management & Reporting: Lead major incident calls

and coordinate technical response efforts. Ensure detailed

incident documentation, root cause analysis, and follow-up actions

are completed. Generate and analyze network performance and

incident trend reports for management and stakeholders.

● SLA Compliance: Monitor service delivery against SLAs; Drive

incident response efficiency and timely escalation; Investigate SLA

breaches and lead corrective actions

● Network Monitoring: Continuously monitor network performance,

health, and security using various monitoring tools to ensure

uptime and reliability.

● Technical Involvement: Assist with technical tickets, incl.

analysis of speed issues, latency, and site/circuit downtime; Utilize

tools like the CATO management portal to analyze graphs and

metrics; Understand and troubleshoot performance-related

anomalies using technical insight; Serve as a go-to resource for

  • diagnosing recurring or complex network issues


Qualifications:

● Education & Certifications (optional): Bachelor's degree in IT,

Computer Science, or related field (preferred). Certifications like

CCNA, CCNP, MTCNA, CompTIA Network+, or equivalent are a

plus.

● Real experience with SD-WAN technology, Cato sockets, Cisco Meraki,

etc.

● Technical Knowledge: Advanced understanding of networking

protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, etc.), firewalls, VPNs, and

monitoring tools (e.g., Zabbix, Grafana, etc.).

● Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in a NOC or network

engineering role, with recent experience in a Senior/Lead capacity.

● Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to diagnose and resolve network

and connectivity issues efficiently.

● Monitoring & Incident Management: Experience using NMS

tools, handling alerts, and escalating critical incidents.

● Operating Systems: Familiarity with Windows, Cisco IOS, and

cloud environments.

● Security Awareness: Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices,

intrusion detection, and network hardening.

● Excellent leadership, communication, and analytical skills

●Fluent in English


Mindy Support is a global company. We empower businesses all over the world through providing remote assistants and outsourced teams specialized in customer support, tech support, back office activities, and agile sales and marketing support.


We respect the individuality and culture of each member of our large team, and appreciate the contribution of each employee to support our Customers.


We will be glad to welcome you to our team. Grow your career with Mindy Support!

title: Data Analyst (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Minimum 4 years of experience as a Data Analyst
  • Proven experience with Python, Power BI, and Google Analytics
  • Professional proficiency in English (B2)
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!


The future is waiting for you — and so are we!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract; Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Node Sênior #998062
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!


The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Mulesoft Architect and Developer
description:

  • 3+ years of Mulesoft experience with implementing service-oriented architecture (SOA) and enterprise application integration (EAI) using Mulesoft 3.x
  • Designs and develops using EAI/B2B solution on B2B tools and J2EE concepts.
  • Experienced in J2EE, Java Servlets, JMS, EJB, Design Patterns, Web services and building integration projects using any integration tool.
  • Solid programming experience using Java, XPath, and XSL/T, J2EE based web applications (JSP, Servlet, JDBC, JMS, JAXB), Design Patterns, JMS, SOAP / REST Web Services, XSLT, CXF, Spring Framework, etc. in order to deliver solutions. Strong knowledge of EAI/SOA best practices, development methodologies & standards
  • Solid programming skills using Experienced troubleshooting Mule ESB, including working with debuggers, flow analyzers and configuration tools.
  • Proficient in the Agile SDLC development
  • Experience working with RAML using Mulesoft
  • Solid hands-on experience in architecting and developing Expert level experience with SOAP and REST web services, open API development, and SOA concepts. Ability to create SOAP and REST based service interfaces using MuleSoft’s Mule Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) platform to deliver fast, reliable, and scalable integration API code.
  • Solid understanding of the design patterns
  • Experience with MuleSoft MMC and Enterprise release capabilities is a plus
