  • Prepare Low Level Design (LLD) documents for APIs and integrations following enterprise standards.
  • Design and develop REST and SOAP APIs using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and Anypoint Studio.
  • Implement data transformations using DataWeave and handle error/exception scenarios effectively.
  • Perform unit testing, system integration testing, and defect fixing for developed MuleSoft components.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and deployments across environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Production).
  • Participate in production releases, post‑deployment validation, and stabilization support.
  • Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and API specifications with proper version control.

Roles & Responsibilities


  • Strong hands‑on experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform (Mule 4.x).
  • Experience developing REST/JSON and SOAP/XML integrations.
  • Proficiency in DataWeave, API Manager, and Anypoint Exchange.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD tools (Git, GitLab, Jenkins, etc.).
  • Experience in integration patterns, error handling, and security concepts (OAuth 2.0, tokens).
  • Good understanding of SDLC and Agile methodologies.

title: Level Designer / Environment Artist
description:
A Mobtex Softwares desenvolve softwares que trazem resultados reais para seus clientes, reduzindo custos, aumentando a produtividade dos recursos e inovando em variados segmentos de mercado. Atuamos com tecnologia, criatividade e visão de produto para construir soluções digitais e experiências interativas que geram impacto concreto.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Level Designer com forte sensibilidade visual, boa leitura da experiência do jogador e familiaridade com o novo normal do desenvolvimento de jogos com apoio de LLMs e ferramentas de IA .


Procuramos alguém que não apenas monte fases, mas que saiba transformar uma proposta de jogo em uma experiência bonita, clara, coerente e bem resolvida visualmente , usando com inteligência assets prontos, Blender, referências visuais e iteração rápida com times técnicos e criativos.


O que esperamos desse perfil
  • Criar e estruturar fases, cenas e ambientes com boa leitura espacial, ritmo e composição visual
  • Trabalhar com graybox, layout, pacing, flow e organização da experiência do jogador
  • Utilizar Blender para montagem, ajustes, otimização e adaptação de assets e cenas
  • Saber integrar e combinar assets prontos com bom gosto, consistência estética e senso de direção visual
  • Colaborar com programadores, designers e equipes de produto para transformar documentos conceituais em experiências jogáveis
  • Usar LLMs e ferramentas de IA de forma prática no fluxo de trabalho: pesquisa, documentação, breakdown de tarefas, geração de variações, refinamento de ideias e aceleração de produção
  • Ter atenção a otimização de cena , organização de arquivos, reaproveitamento inteligente de recursos e eficiência de produção
  • Participar do refinamento visual e funcional das fases, elevando a qualidade final do jogo


Requisitos
  • Experiência com level design , montagem de ambientes ou world building para jogos
  • Domínio prático de Blender para edição, adaptação, composição e otimização de assets e cenas
  • Boa noção de composição visual, escala, iluminação, leitura de cenário e clareza espacial
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com assets prontos e de marketplace sem deixar o resultado genérico ou inconsistente
  • Familiaridade com pipelines modernos de produção, incluindo uso de IA / LLMs como ferramenta de produtividade
  • Boa comunicação com equipes multidisciplinares
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com atenção a acabamento


Diferenciais
  • Experiência com Godot
  • Vivência com jogos educacionais, serious games ou experiências interativas com objetivos pedagógicos
  • Capacidade de criar props ou elementos 3D simples quando necessário
  • Noção de direção de arte, environment art ou visual development
  • Experiência com otimização para projetos multiplataforma


O que valorizamos

Valorizamos profissionais que entendam que desenvolver jogos hoje exige saber combinar visão criativa, repertório visual, ferramentas tradicionais e apoio inteligente de IA para produzir melhor, com mais velocidade, consistência e qualidade.

Buscamos alguém com bom senso estético, autonomia e vontade real de construir experiências que sejam ao mesmo tempo funcionais, bonitas e memoráveis.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Elite Executive Assistant to CEO For U.S. Online Brand

Full-Time | Remote | Working U.S. Central Hours | Work Directly with the Founder


We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to Austin Netzley, CEO of 2X.


This is not a typical assistant role.


This is for someone who wants to operate as a true right hand to a founder — helping build, organize, and execute across both business and life.


If you love systems, execution, speed, and turning chaos into clarity, this role will be incredibly rewarding.


About 2X &

At 2X (2X.co), we help founders scale their businesses while getting their time back. We have coaching programs, online community, and in-person events. 


At , we help small businesses implement the proven systems and strategies to optimize their team and operations so they can scale faster with more freedom. 


We focus on building businesses that:

- Run on systems (not the founder)

- Scale with more profit and less complexity

- Create real freedom and long-term value


We move fast, operate at a high standard, and care deeply about doing meaningful work that impacts entrepreneurs and their families. 


The Mission of This Role

Your mission is simple:


Protect and free up the CEO’s time as a right hand partner to help handle a lot of the details and tasks that can bog him down. 


You will operate as a leverage multiplier — ensuring the right things get done, at the right time, with high quality.


This role is about ownership, anticipation, and execution… with a strong attention to detail, a love for systems, producing efficiently, and being able to wear numerous hats with different tasks and responsibilities. 


The Outcomes You Own

This role is responsible for ensuring:


1. CEO Time is Protected and Optimized

Calendar reflects true priorities, not noise.


2. Communication is Clean and Controlled

Email, Slack, and external communication are organized, timely, and proactive.


3. Projects Move Without Bottlenecks

Key initiatives progress quickly without the CEO needing to follow up.


4. Personal + Business Logistics Run Seamlessly

Travel, scheduling, events, and life logistics are handled smoothly.


5. Events Are Executed at a High Level

Masterminds and experiences are well-organized and on-brand.


6. The Team Stays Aligned and Supported

Basic HR, onboarding, and internal coordination run cleanly.


7. Systems Are Built (Not Just Tasks Completed)

Work becomes organized, repeatable, and scalable over time.


Core Responsibilities


1. Executive Support (Business)

  • Own email + communication flow
  • Manage calendar with strong prioritization
  • Coordinate business travel and logistics
  • Conduct research and prep materials
  • Support slides, docs, and key initiatives
  • Maintain ClickUp task organization


2. Personal Support

  • Plan and coordinate personal travel
  • Schedule personal appointments and events
  • Manage gifts and special occasions
  • Handle health, insurance, and admin logistics
  • Coordinate with household support


3. Event Coordination (Masterminds)

  • Coordinate venues, food, and activities
  • Manage communication with clients, vendors, and speakers
  • Support on-site execution (when applicable)
  • Maintain event systems and checklists


  • 4. Team & HR Support
  • Support team communication and culture
  • Track reports, scorecards, and metrics
  • Coordinate onboarding and access for new hires
  • Manage team gifts, time off, and logistics
  • Assist with hiring and screening when needed


5. Marketing & Founder Support (Light)

  • Coordinate with media team as needed
  • Support social posting or content logistics
  • Assist with podcast and PR coordination


The Ideal Candidate

You are not just organized — you are operationally sharp.


You likely:

  • Learn fast and figure things out without hand-holding
  • Are extremely organized and detail-oriented
  • Execute quickly while maintaining quality
  • Anticipate needs before being told
  • Take full ownership of outcomes
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Are tech-savvy and comfortable with tools
  • Use AI tools to increase speed and output
  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-performance environments


You are the type of person who:

Sees something messy → fixes it → systemizes it → improves it.


What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

Within your first 60–90 days:

- CEO calendar is always clean, structured, and optimized

- Communication is streamlined and proactive

- Travel and logistics run smoothly without friction

- Key projects are moving forward without bottlenecks

- Event systems are organized and ready for execution

- Core workflows are documented and improving


Why This Role Is Different

Direct access to the founder

- You’ll work side-by-side with the CEO on real decisions and execution.


High ownership, not task-taking

- You are expected to think, improve, and operate — not just follow instructions.


Massive learning curve

- You’ll see how a high-performing founder operates across business and life.


Variety + speed

- No two weeks look the same — this role touches everything.


Opportunity to grow


Logistics

  • Location: Remote position
  • Hours: 40 hours/week
  • Compensation: based on experience and skills 


We are looking for a long-term fit only. There will be numerous opportunities to advance into other roles if you desire, but this EA role is ideally a long-term position for you.


How to Apply

If you’re someone who wants to operate as a true right hand — and take ownership in a fast-moving environment — we’d love to hear from you.


Apply with:

  • Your resume
  • A short paragraph or few lines on why this role excites you
  • Your email address 


We’ll then review and be in touch!

title: Business-Content Writer - 2026
description:
BR SERVICES is looking for enthusiastic professionals with outstanding business-writing skills


  • TITLE : Business-Content Writer
  • HIRING : Part- or Full-time/contractor
  • LOCATION : Home office/contractor’s premises
  • AREA / MAJOR: Consultancy/Business Planning
  • RESUMES TO :


If you have a strong written English level and want to work from the comfort of your home, this might be the right opportunity. Come and join our amazing team from all over the world!


We are a Brazilian company specializing in enterprise solutions that provides consulting services to clients globally. Our know-how ranges from management, information, technology, and finance. Our client’s vast business field will demand your curiosity and ability to research.  



MAIN TASKS


The main responsibility of the consultants is to produce the business narrative, that is, the descriptive content of Business Plans and other consultancy reports. In addition to being proficient in the grammar and rules of style of the American English, they should have strong writing skills, enabling them to express ideas elegantly and effectively.

The narrative aims to explain the Plan to the reader. Therefore, a Business Plan Document will typically describe the endeavor our client intends to launch, including the products the new company will sell, the region it will reach, the staff it will hire, etc. 


The Business-Content Writer Consultant will work in partnership with a financial consultant to produce and write Business Plans for our clients. These Plans are addressed to Government agencies and ultimately aim to obtain any type of business visa in the target country. Therefore, the following skills are essential:


  • Ability to understand our customer profile and business needs
  • Creative writing, with the ability to craft strategies and arguments, often with little background information.
  • Research relevant industry trends, trajectory, competition, the economics of targeted regions, and benchmark milestones;
  • Analyze the market strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats;
  • Connect and aggregate the ideas;
  • Rearrange them in a cohesive and clear text;
  • Proofread and ensure all-around consistency
  • Finally but not least, meet the deadline.


PROFILE AND COMPETENCIES

MANDATORY

  • >= 18 y. o.
  • Bachelor's degree 
  • Advanced proficiency in English;
  • Exceptional writing skills;
  • Advanced skills in MS Word (/compatible);
  • Beginner to intermediate skills in MS Excel;
  • Ability to meet deadlines;
  • Team-player mentality with excellent communication skills;
  • Passionate and curious with web surfer/effective search skills;
  • Attention to detail;


DESIRABLE

  • Intermediate to advanced skills in MS Excel
  • Intermediate skills in MS PowerPoint
  • Page/Graphic design capabilities
  • Studies in Marketing, Journalism, Letters, English

THE FIRM

BR SERVICES provides consulting services as well as document & linguistic solutions for customers such as companies in many industries, universities, or government agencies

Headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, BR Services is incorporated with the company name of Lili Schneider Serviços Corporativos Ltda., under the Brazilian corporate taxpayer registry (CNPJ) N° / .


Our portfolio has solutions in two main Streams or Practices


1) CONSULTANCY PRACTICE

Our consultancy team provides business advice in areas such as management, information technology, and finance. Among the various products within the practice, Business Planning stands out as the flagship of the consultancy portfolio.


Our Business Plans chiefly focus on assessing and planning businesses to be established in the United States. They have swiftly become actual roadmaps to success for companies and entrepreneurs in their business expansion or their venture to enter a new business vertical. Our Plans have also served as a bridge to the US market for foreign investors, mostly from Brazil and other Latin American countries.


2) TRANSLATION AND LINGUISTICS PRACTICE


Based on our vast experience delivering premium translation, proofreading, copywriting, and ghostwriting services, we have acquired a solid reputation among corporate clients in Brazil and abroad.


On the other hand, our performance in this area is also specially acknowledged within academia. A reference in the translation of scientific papers, BR SERVICES is an accredited partner for scientific journals and maintains agreements for providing translation services with universities and other teaching institutions.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Estamos em busca de um AI Engineer para atuar na evolução da plataforma, com foco na construção de sistemas inteligentes baseados em LLMs, agentes e bases de conhecimento.


Essa pessoa fará parte do time de engenharia e será responsável por desenvolver soluções de IA aplicadas ao produto, integrando modelos de linguagem com dados reais, sistemas internos e fluxos de negócio.

O que é um diferencial:

title: Customer Success Coordinator/Account Manager
description:
Company Description

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology. As we scale our platform, strong delivery discipline and cross-functional coordination are critical.


Headshots.com is seeking a Customer Success Coordinator to support post-launch customer engagement, account coordination, and internal systems upkeep. This role helps ensure a smooth, high-quality experience for customers through consistent execution and strong coordination across teams.


The ideal candidate brings a high level of organization, reliability, and comfort working at the intersection of customer communication, systems accuracy, and cross-functional team collaboration.


Core Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Account Support

  • Conduct monthly check-ins with launched teams to maintain engagement, gather feedback, and surface potential expansion or upsell opportunities.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned team accounts after launch, handling questions, updates, and general account support.
  • Escalate complex issues or commercial conversations to senior leadership as needed.

Training & Enablement Support

  • Lead or co-lead admin and team training sessions on how to submit usable photos (lighting, framing, attire, common errors).
  • Manage live Q&A during trainings using prepared materials and documented best practices.
  • Capture recurring questions and feedback to improve documentation and training assets over time.

Account Management & Operational Advocacy

  • Serve as a coordination point across Customer Success, Production, and internal teams to ensure customer uploads and deliverables move smoothly through established workflows.
  • Maintain regular update cadences and ensure files, approvals, and records are accurately tracked and archived.
  • Act as an advocate for both customers and internal teams by identifying process gaps, reducing friction, and surfacing opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define requirements and support the transition from manual tracking to more scalable, automated systems over time.


CRM & Data Hygiene (Pipedrive)

  • Keep Pipedrive records current for organizations and deals, ensuring required fields are completed for reporting, visibility, and handoffs.
  • Flag repeat manual work that should be automated and document requirements clearly for Dev.


Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal English language skills
  • 3+ years in customer success, operations, or administrative support.
  • 2+ years of sales experience.
  • Strong written communication and customer-facing professionalism.
  • Experience working with CRMs (Pipedrive, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Comfortable coordinating across Customer Success, Production, Sales, and Dev.
  • Highly organized, dependable, and able to follow recurring cadences.


Preferred

  • Experience running customer trainings or onboarding sessions.
  • Familiarity with SaaS-style account management or subscription services.

description:

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


*O que você precisa ter

Requisitos mandatórios

• Formação concluída preferencialmente na área de TI;

• Vivências anteriores como desenvolvedor ABAP para SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA;

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de objetos RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms);

• Vivência em análise e depuração (debugging) de programas ABAP;

• Conhecimento da linguagem de programação ABAP e ABAP Orientado a Objetos;

• Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento ABAP (SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37, Eclipse com ADT);

• Conhecimento em Dicionário de Dados ABAP (DDIC);

• Experiência com técnicas de enhancement (User-Exits, Customer-Exits, BADIs, Enhancement Spots);

• Habilidade com desenvolvimento de relatórios (ALV Grid/Tree);

• Familiaridade com a criação de formulários (SmartForms e/ou Adobe Forms);

• Noções de performance tuning em ABAP.


Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais):

• Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5;

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

• Conhecimento em módulos funcionais SAP (ex: SD, MM, FI, CO) para melhor entendimento dos requisitos.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (relatórios, interfaces, conversões, enhancements, formulários - RICEF) no ambiente SAP S/4HANA, seguindo as especificações funcionais e técnicas;

• Realizar correções de bugs, otimizações de performance e ajustes em códigos ABAP existentes (código Z), aplicando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e garantindo a qualidade do código;

• Criar e executar testes unitários e integrados para garantir a qualidade e a robustez das entregas de software;

• Aplicar metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e as ferramentas de gestão de código e versionamento utilizadas pelo Grupo Sipal;

• Manter a documentação técnica dos desenvolvimentos clara, completa e atualizada;

• Participar de revisões de código (code review) e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos padrões de desenvolvimento da equipe;

• Prestar suporte técnico Nível 3 para incidentes complexos que exijam análise aprofundada de código ABAP, identificando e implementando soluções eficazes;

• Pesquisar e se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e abordagens de desenvolvimento no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA (ex: ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, OData).

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Outbound Call Center Operator (Customer Care) – HVAC Industry  Remote Position – Based in Brazil | Serving U.S. Customers
description:
Role Summary


We are seeking motivated Outbound Call Center Operators to support our HVAC service operations in the United States. This role focuses on proactive customer outreach, scheduling preventive maintenance appointments and safety inspections for homeowners.


The primary goal of this position is to generate service demand and maintain a steady flow of scheduled appointments for field technicians. By contacting existing and past customers, the operator helps prevent equipment breakdowns and ensures customers receive reliable comfort in their homes.


Success in this role means consistently scheduling maintenance visits, delivering a positive customer experience, and maintaining accurate CRM records. This position is an important part of the company's customer care and service operations, directly supporting the productivity of field technicians.


Responsibilities


• Make outbound calls to customers in the company database to schedule HVAC maintenance visits and inspections.


• Contact different customer groups including Comfort Club members, inactive customers, and new prospects.


• Present the company’s preventive maintenance offers and service guarantees clearly and professionally.


• Schedule appointments for HVAC tune-ups and inspections according to technician availability.


• Conduct customer satisfaction follow-up calls (\"Happy Calls\") after service visits.


• Record call outcomes, customer information, and appointment details in the CRM system.


• Follow company call scripts and communication guidelines to maintain consistency and professionalism.


• Maintain productivity targets related to calls made and appointments scheduled.


• Coordinate with the scheduling and dispatch teams when necessary to ensure accurate appointment management.


• Maintain a positive and professional tone during all customer interactions.


Qualifications

Skills


• Fluent English communication skills (spoken and written).

• Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.

• Ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive attitude during outbound calls.

• Strong organization and time management skills.

• Comfortable using computers, CRM systems, and scheduling tools.

• Fast and accurate typing skills.


Experience


• Previous experience in customer service, sales, telemarketing, or call center environments is preferred.


• Experience with outbound calling or appointment setting is a strong advantage.


• Experience working with U.S. customers or international support teams is a plus.


Work Requirements


• Quiet and professional home office environment.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection.

• Ability to work during U.S. business hours.

• Strong focus and discipline during outbound calling periods.

title: [Tech] Cientista de Dados (REMOTO)

Já conhece a Galgar Digital?


Somos uma Assessoria de Marketing Digital focada em alta performance, desenvolvemos uma área digital e comercial no cliente facilitando o aumento de vendas e crescimento do negócio.


Aqui, você irá trabalhar com um time apaixonado por desafios, focado no atendimento personalizado aos nossos clientes e em busca dos melhores resultados em suas entregas. Quer mais? Tudo isso em um ambiente descontraído e com uma galera que é referência no mercado de Marketing!


Estamos em busca de um Gestor, com sólida experiência em tráfego pago, para integrar nossa equipe! O candidato ideal terá a missão de planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas que alavanquem o crescimento dos nossos clientes. Se você tem habilidades comprovadas em mídia paga e profundo conhecimento das tendências de marketing digital, queremos conhecer você!


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias digitais completas, com foco em campanhas de tráfego pago para aumentar a visibilidade e as conversões dos clientes;


  • Gerenciar campanhas de mídia paga em plataformas como Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, LinkedIn Ads, entre outras;


  • Monitorar o desempenho das campanhas, realizar testes A/B e otimizar táticas para maximizar o ROI;


  • Colaborar com a equipe de criação para garantir que os anúncios sejam atraentes e alinhados com a identidade das marcas;


  • Analisar dados de campanhas e gerar relatórios com insights e recomendações para os clientes;


  • Agendar reuniões de acesso e resultados com clientes e equipe;


  • Responder dúvidas sobre tráfego e desempenho nos grupos de WhatsApp dos clientes do seu squad;


  • Gerenciar o orçamento de mídia paga, garantindo que os gastos estejam alinhados aos objetivos do cliente.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como Estrategista Digital, Gestor de Tráfego ou função similar.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Google Ads, Facebook Ads e outras plataformas de anúncios.
  • Experiência em análise de dados e uso de ferramentas como Google Analytics, SEMrush, HubSpot.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar múltiplos projetos.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade para apresentar resultados aos clientes.
  • Conhecimento em SEO e marketing de conteúdo é um diferencial.


O que oferecemos:


- Contrato PJ: R$ 2.500,00 (Inicial)

- Trabalho Remoto

- Acesso a cursos e mentorias

- Brindes e vouchers por reconhecimento

title: Banco de Talentos GFT -  Desenvolvimento Front-end Angular
description:
Banco de Talentos | Desenvolvimento Front-end (Angular)


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Desenvolvimento Front-end com Angular, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em experiência do usuário, performance e inovação.


Se você busca oportunidades para evoluir sua carreira e trabalhar com tecnologias modernas, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações front-end utilizando Angular;
  • Construir interfaces modernas, responsivas e performáticas;
  • Trabalhar com consumo de APIs e integração com serviços back-end;
  • Garantir boas práticas de usabilidade, acessibilidade e experiência do usuário (UX/UI);
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (design, produto, back-end);
  • Contribuir com padrões de código, componentização e arquitetura front-end;
  • Participar de code reviews e melhoria contínua da qualidade das entregas.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end utilizando Angular;
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 e CSS3;
  • Experiência com conceitos e ferramentas do ecossistema Angular (RxJS, Services, Modules, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com consumo de APIs RESTful;
  • Conhecimento em responsividade e compatibilidade entre navegadores;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Noções de testes (unitários e/ou integração) são um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de arquitetura front-end;
  • Interesse por qualidade de código e melhoria contínua.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade e vontade de aprender continuamente;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho;
  • Interesse por inovação, design e experiência do usuário.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: Node.Js Developer | Senior
description:
Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma das arcas da empresa global AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Procurar sempre criar a melhor experiência de uso para o usuário final, trabalhando de forma colaborativa com desenvolvedores, designers e stakeholders para garantir o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente na resolução de problemas complexos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções inovadoras;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, de fácil manutenção, utilizando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de revisão de código, atuando tanto como revisor quanto como autor, garantindo a qualidade e a funcionalidade das features desenvolvidas;
  • Acompanhar o comportamento das aplicações em produção usando as principais métricas de saúde e performance disponíveis nas ferramentas de monitoração, buscando insights de melhorias e entendendo anomalias a partir dessas métricas;
  • Atuar no backend que é a interface de consumo dos dados para todos os front-ends, garantindo resiliência e suporte à alta carga de acessos simultâneos;
  • Contribuir com a aplicação responsável pela entrega do site web do produto, utilizando o ambiente como campo de experimentação e aprendizado sobre o comportamento dos usuários.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Node.JS
  • Conhecimentos sólidos do sistema de controle de versão Git;
  • Visão sobre design patterns (Criacionais, Estruturais e Comportamentais);
  • Domínio de boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (DRY, KISS, TDA, SoC, SOLID);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos da biblioteca React;
  • Experiência com testes unitários em JavaScript;
  • Domínio de design de APIs REST (preferencialmente com o framework Express);
  • Visão do modelo arquitetural de micro-serviços;
  • Experiência com design responsivo (media queries, propriedades relativas, flexbox, CSS grid);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de JavaScript e domínio dos paradigmas orientado a objetos e funcional da linguagem;
  • Conhecimento sobre GraphQL (preferencialmente com o framework Apollo);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoração (métricas de performance e erros);
  • Experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de hint/lint (preferencialmente ESLint).




Remoto no Brasil

title: [Tech] Cientista de Dados (REMOTO)
description:
Descrição da vaga

A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes.

Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade.

O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos.
  • Realizar exploração, tratamento e modelagem de dados para gerar insights estratégicos.
  • Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas.
  • Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados.
  • Contribuir com a documentação técnica e boas práticas de ciência de dados.
  • Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e UX para garantir integração fluida das soluções ao produto final.
  • Participar de testes, validações e iterações de modelos em ambiente de produção.
  • Acompanhar tendências e inovações na área de dados e inteligência artificial, especialmente em aplicações de RH.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Graduação completa em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prática com modelagem estatística, machine learning e análise exploratória de dados.
  • Domínio de linguagens como Python (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, etc.) e SQL.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos e aplicações de LLMs (Large Language Models).
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Experiência prévia com dados de RH ou People Analytics.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização (ex: Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, Dash, etc.).
  • Experiência com deployment de modelos em ambiente de produção.
  • Pós-graduação ou cursos especializados em Ciência de Dados ou IA.



Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.

title: Analista de testes sênior
description:

Como Analista de QA, você será peça-chave na estabilidade e evolução de soluções ERP, assegurando que cada entrega funcione com precisão, performance e confiabilidade.


Aqui, qualidade não é só testar — é entender o negócio, antecipar riscos e garantir uma experiência sólida para o usuário final.

Planejar e executar testes funcionais e não funcionais em sistemas ERP

Validar integrações entre sistemas (APIs, serviços, etc.)

Executar consultas em banco de dados (SQL) para validação de dados

Identificar, documentar e acompanhar bugs até a resolução

Atuar próximo ao time de desenvolvimento e produto

Experiência como QA/Testes em sistemas ERP ou sistemas complexos

Conhecimento sólido em testes funcionais e regressivos

Experiência com Selenium (automação de testes)

Conhecimento em SQL para validação de dados

Experiência com documentação de testes e gestão de bugs

Boa comunicação com times técnicos e de negócio

⭐ Diferenciais

Experiência com testes de APIs (Postman, Insomnia, etc.)

Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

Conhecimento em CI/CD (pipeline de testes automatizados)

Experiência com testes em sistemas financeiros ou operacionais

Noções de performance e testes de carga

title: OT Generalist
description:
Pay: 10k-13.5k Brazilian Reals per Month

Title: Travel OT Generalis

Location: Brazil (70% travel)

Openings: 1

Start date: ASAP


Must Have:

  • 3+ years in an OT (industrial) environment within IT functions - Technical knowledge of OT systems and infrastructure
  • Specialization in at least one OT area
  • Versatility in OT tasks
  • Cybersecurity knowledge
  • Must be able to travel at least 70% of the time


Job Description:

The OT Generalist is a versatile role responsible for a wide range of tasks within the operational technology environment. This includes conducting health reviews, evaluating server infrastructure, creating domain controllers, and working with the network engineer to do on-site network configuration and troubleshooting. The OT Generalist will also be involved in creating and managing OU structures, GPOs, and DNS reverse lookup zones.


Key Responsibilities:

  • On-Site cutover of systems.
  • Conduct secondary health reviews of domains.
  • Evaluate server infrastructure capacity and request quotes for new equipment if needed.
  • Create and configure domain controllers and trusts.
  • Manage OU structures, GPOs, and Sites and Services.
  • Create and connect process machines to appropriate domains.
  • Ensure proper patching and security tool setup for all machines.
  • Specialize in at least one area of OT to provide deep expertise when needed.
  • Install and configure security tools as needed.

title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
• Remote in LATAM
  • 12-month contract with potential extensions


Job Description:

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join a growing AI and data engineering team focused on building production‑ready AI products. This role sits at the intersection of data/ML pipelines, MLOps, and applied generative AI, supporting initiatives such as forecasting, inventory intelligence, and conversational/agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate is hands‑on, comfortable moving from prototype to production, and excited about building scalable ML/AI systems. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain data and machine learning pipelines to support AI‑driven products and analytics. Develop and productionize LLM‑based solutions, including conversational and agentic AI use cases. Implement MLOps best practices, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, and deployment workflows. Collaborate on AI prototyping efforts, rapidly validating ideas and transitioning successful prototypes into production systems. Work with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph to support AI workflows and automation. Support initiatives related to forecasting and inventory intelligence, including contributions to a unified UI that explains what forecasts are and why they are generated. Partner closely with data engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, business‑facing AI solutions. Contribute to cloud‑based architectures, with exposure to Azure (primary) and GCP (emerging footprint) as part of an upcoming cloud migration.



Required Skills:

- 5+ years of experience in ML Engineering

- Strong experience with Python for data and machine learning development.

- Advanced SQL skills for data analysis and pipeline development.

- Hands‑on experience building data/ML pipelines (minimum baseline expectation).

- Solid understanding of MLOps, including CI/CD practices for ML systems.

- Experience working with LLMs and modern AI tooling (e.g., ChatGPT, OpenAI APIs).

- Familiarity with LangChain and LangGraph for orchestration of AI workflows.

- Experience working in cloud environments, primarily Azure, with some exposure or interest in GCP


Compensation: $20-24/hour Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

description:
Role Summary


We are seeking motivated Outbound Call Center Operators to support our HVAC service operations in the United States. This role focuses on proactive customer outreach, scheduling preventive maintenance appointments and safety inspections for homeowners.


The primary goal of this position is to generate service demand and maintain a steady flow of scheduled appointments for field technicians. By contacting existing and past customers, the operator helps prevent equipment breakdowns and ensures customers receive reliable comfort in their homes.


Success in this role means consistently scheduling maintenance visits, delivering a positive customer experience, and maintaining accurate CRM records. This position is an important part of the company's customer care and service operations, directly supporting the productivity of field technicians.


Responsibilities


• Make outbound calls to customers in the company database to schedule HVAC maintenance visits and inspections.


• Contact different customer groups including Comfort Club members, inactive customers, and new prospects.


• Present the company’s preventive maintenance offers and service guarantees clearly and professionally.


• Schedule appointments for HVAC tune-ups and inspections according to technician availability.


• Conduct customer satisfaction follow-up calls (\"Happy Calls\") after service visits.


• Record call outcomes, customer information, and appointment details in the CRM system.


• Follow company call scripts and communication guidelines to maintain consistency and professionalism.


• Maintain productivity targets related to calls made and appointments scheduled.


• Coordinate with the scheduling and dispatch teams when necessary to ensure accurate appointment management.


• Maintain a positive and professional tone during all customer interactions.


Qualifications

Skills


• Fluent English communication skills (spoken and written).

• Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.

• Ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive attitude during outbound calls.

• Strong organization and time management skills.

• Comfortable using computers, CRM systems, and scheduling tools.

• Fast and accurate typing skills.


Experience


• Previous experience in customer service, sales, telemarketing, or call center environments is preferred.


• Experience with outbound calling or appointment setting is a strong advantage.


• Experience working with U.S. customers or international support teams is a plus.


Work Requirements


• Quiet and professional home office environment.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection.

• Ability to work during U.S. business hours.

• Strong focus and discipline during outbound calling periods.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: AI Automations Engineer
description:
About Evvolve & Partners

Evvolve & Partners connects a select group of founders and investors through our private network, Evvolve Circle. With $2B+ in completed transactions and relationships with 305+ family offices globally, we facilitate highly curated introductions in the private markets.


You can learn more about our platform and .


The Role

We are hiring an AI Automation Engineer to help build and own the internal automation systems that power our deal flow and investor engagement.


This role sits at the intersection of operations, data, and AI-driven workflows. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining complex automation processes that connect our core systems, structure internal data, and support communication with investors and founders. You will play a key role in building scalable workflows that improve operational efficiency and ensure reliable information flow across our platform.

  • Design and manage multi-step automation workflows using n8n to support internal operations
  • Build systems that connect and synchronize data across Supabase, Attio, and Airtable

  • 2–4 years experience in automation engineering, workflow architecture, or low-code development
  • Strong experience building workflows in n8n or similar platforms (Make, Zapier, Retool, etc.)
  • Comfortable working with APIs, JSON data structures, and workflow logic
  • Experience working with databases and writing SQL queries (Supabase/PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Familiarity with integrating AI APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic within automated workflows
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on building reliable, scalable systems
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to take ownership of internal tooling and automation


Why Evvolve?

  • Direct exposure to senior management and the opportunity to contribute to core operational systems
  • A lean, merit-based environment where strong work and initiative are quickly recognized
  • A fast-paced, fully remote team focused on building efficient, high-impact internal tools

title: Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno
description:
Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno


*Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


*O que você precisa ter

Requisitos mandatórios

• Formação concluída preferencialmente na área de TI;

• Vivências anteriores como desenvolvedor ABAP para SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA;

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de objetos RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms);

• Vivência em análise e depuração (debugging) de programas ABAP;

• Conhecimento da linguagem de programação ABAP e ABAP Orientado a Objetos;

• Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento ABAP (SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37, Eclipse com ADT);

• Conhecimento em Dicionário de Dados ABAP (DDIC);

• Experiência com técnicas de enhancement (User-Exits, Customer-Exits, BADIs, Enhancement Spots);

• Habilidade com desenvolvimento de relatórios (ALV Grid/Tree);

• Familiaridade com a criação de formulários (SmartForms e/ou Adobe Forms);

• Noções de performance tuning em ABAP.


Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais):

• Experiência com desenvolvimento em SAP S/4HANA (CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, ABAP RAP);

• Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de interfaces (IDocs, Proxies, RFCs, Web Services);

• Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5;

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

• Conhecimento em módulos funcionais SAP (ex: SD, MM, FI, CO) para melhor entendimento dos requisitos.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (relatórios, interfaces, conversões, enhancements, formulários - RICEF) no ambiente SAP S/4HANA, seguindo as especificações funcionais e técnicas;

• Realizar correções de bugs, otimizações de performance e ajustes em códigos ABAP existentes (código Z), aplicando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e garantindo a qualidade do código;

• Analisar especificações funcionais e técnicas para propor as melhores soluções de desenvolvimento ABAP;

• Criar e executar testes unitários e integrados para garantir a qualidade e a robustez das entregas de software;

• Aplicar metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e as ferramentas de gestão de código e versionamento utilizadas pelo Grupo Sipal;

• Colaborar ativamente com analistas funcionais, outros desenvolvedores e áreas de negócio para entender os requisitos e entregar soluções que agreguem valor;

• Manter a documentação técnica dos desenvolvimentos clara, completa e atualizada;

• Participar de revisões de código (code review) e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos padrões de desenvolvimento da equipe;

• Prestar suporte técnico Nível 3 para incidentes complexos que exijam análise aprofundada de código ABAP, identificando e implementando soluções eficazes;

• Pesquisar e se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e abordagens de desenvolvimento no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA (ex: ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, OData).


*Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Customer Success Coordinator/Account Manager
description:
Company Description

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology. As we scale our platform, strong delivery discipline and cross-functional coordination are critical.


Headshots.com is seeking a Customer Success Coordinator to support post-launch customer engagement, account coordination, and internal systems upkeep. This role helps ensure a smooth, high-quality experience for customers through consistent execution and strong coordination across teams.


The ideal candidate brings a high level of organization, reliability, and comfort working at the intersection of customer communication, systems accuracy, and cross-functional team collaboration.


Core Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Account Support

  • Conduct monthly check-ins with launched teams to maintain engagement, gather feedback, and surface potential expansion or upsell opportunities.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned team accounts after launch, handling questions, updates, and general account support.
  • Escalate complex issues or commercial conversations to senior leadership as needed.

Training & Enablement Support

  • Lead or co-lead admin and team training sessions on how to submit usable photos (lighting, framing, attire, common errors).
  • Manage live Q&A during trainings using prepared materials and documented best practices.
  • Capture recurring questions and feedback to improve documentation and training assets over time.

Account Management & Operational Advocacy

  • Serve as a coordination point across Customer Success, Production, and internal teams to ensure customer uploads and deliverables move smoothly through established workflows.
  • Maintain regular update cadences and ensure files, approvals, and records are accurately tracked and archived.
  • Act as an advocate for both customers and internal teams by identifying process gaps, reducing friction, and surfacing opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define requirements and support the transition from manual tracking to more scalable, automated systems over time.


CRM & Data Hygiene (Pipedrive)

  • Keep Pipedrive records current for organizations and deals, ensuring required fields are completed for reporting, visibility, and handoffs.
  • Flag repeat manual work that should be automated and document requirements clearly for Dev.


Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal English language skills
  • 3+ years in customer success, operations, or administrative support.
  • 2+ years of sales experience.
  • Strong written communication and customer-facing professionalism.
  • Experience working with CRMs (Pipedrive, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Comfortable coordinating across Customer Success, Production, Sales, and Dev.
  • Highly organized, dependable, and able to follow recurring cadences.


Preferred

  • Experience running customer trainings or onboarding sessions.
  • Familiarity with SaaS-style account management or subscription services.
  • Process documentation or SOP experience.


Why This Role Matters

This position is not just support—it is a force multiplier. By owning recurring customer and data workflows, this role directly enables Headshots.com to scale accounts, improve retention, and transition from manual effort to system-driven growth.


IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

You will bridge the gap between high-level SEO strategy and technical execution, ensuring our growth is powered by cutting-edge Generative AI and Agentic Workflows .

A1 Beginner

  • AI Specialization: Proven expertise in building market-ready automations and AI-assisted operations using Claude, OpenAI, and REST APIs.

title: SAP Basis / Technical Analyst (Archiving & Support)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender um cliente global do segmento de energia, com forte atuação em projetos de tecnologia e inovação, inserido em um ambiente corporativo robusto, com operações críticas e times distribuídos globalmente. O projeto envolve sustentação e evolução de soluções SAP voltadas à gestão e arquivamento de dados, com alta exigência em performance, disponibilidade e governança da informação.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar com arquivamento de dados e documentos em SAP (ADK/AIS), incluindo execução e recuperação (PrintList, Inbound e Outbound)
  • Configurar e manter Archive InfoStructures (AIS), incluindo catálogo de campos, build/load/unload
  • Tratar falhas em jobs de arquivamento e otimizar processos de execução
  • Atuar com suporte L2/L3 em incidentes e problemas relacionados às soluções de arquivamento SAP
  • Monitorar ambiente (Datadog, scripts PowerShell), garantindo saúde, disponibilidade e performance
  • Acompanhar capacidade do ambiente (CPU, memória, disco, spool) e atuar na resolução de gargalos
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura (atualizações de aplicação, banco, sistema operacional e hardware)
  • Gerar relatórios e indicadores (KPIs) para stakeholders
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada e propor melhorias e automações
  • Atuar em conjunto com times globais na restauração de serviços e troubleshooting

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com SAP Archiving (ADK e AIS)
  • Vivência com objetos de arquivamento (FI_DOCUMNT, SD_VBAK, CO_ITEM, entre outros)
  • Experiência com suporte L2/L3 (incident e problem management)
  • Conhecimento em administração básica de Windows Server
  • Experiência com monitoramento e automação (ex: Datadog, PowerShell)
  • Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting, análise de logs e performance
  • Experiência com jobs de housekeeping e data archiving
  • Inglês avançado para atuação em ambiente global

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimentos em SAP ILM (Retention Management e Retention Warehouse)
  • Noções de ABAP para suporte e ajustes em rotinas de arquivamento
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps e ServiceNow
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e com boa comunicação

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Elite Executive Assistant to CEO For U.S. Online Brand

Full-Time | Remote | Working U.S. Central Hours | Work Directly with the Founder


We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to Austin Netzley, CEO of 2X.


This is not a typical assistant role.


This is for someone who wants to operate as a true right hand to a founder — helping build, organize, and execute across both business and life.


If you love systems, execution, speed, and turning chaos into clarity, this role will be incredibly rewarding.


About 2X &

At 2X (2X.co), we help founders scale their businesses while getting their time back. We have coaching programs, online community, and in-person events. 


At , we help small businesses implement the proven systems and strategies to optimize their team and operations so they can scale faster with more freedom. 


We focus on building businesses that:

- Run on systems (not the founder)

- Scale with more profit and less complexity

- Create real freedom and long-term value


We move fast, operate at a high standard, and care deeply about doing meaningful work that impacts entrepreneurs and their families. 


The Mission of This Role

Your mission is simple:


Protect and free up the CEO’s time as a right hand partner to help handle a lot of the details and tasks that can bog him down. 


You will operate as a leverage multiplier — ensuring the right things get done, at the right time, with high quality.


This role is about ownership, anticipation, and execution… with a strong attention to detail, a love for systems, producing efficiently, and being able to wear numerous hats with different tasks and responsibilities. 


The Outcomes You Own

This role is responsible for ensuring:


1. CEO Time is Protected and Optimized

Calendar reflects true priorities, not noise.


2. Communication is Clean and Controlled

Email, Slack, and external communication are organized, timely, and proactive.


3. Projects Move Without Bottlenecks

Key initiatives progress quickly without the CEO needing to follow up.


4. Personal + Business Logistics Run Seamlessly

Travel, scheduling, events, and life logistics are handled smoothly.


5. Events Are Executed at a High Level

Masterminds and experiences are well-organized and on-brand.


6. The Team Stays Aligned and Supported

Basic HR, onboarding, and internal coordination run cleanly.


7. Systems Are Built (Not Just Tasks Completed)

Work becomes organized, repeatable, and scalable over time.


Core Responsibilities


1. Executive Support (Business)

  • Own email + communication flow
  • Manage calendar with strong prioritization
  • Coordinate business travel and logistics
  • Conduct research and prep materials
  • Support slides, docs, and key initiatives
  • Maintain ClickUp task organization


2. Personal Support

  • Plan and coordinate personal travel
  • Schedule personal appointments and events
  • Manage gifts and special occasions
  • Handle health, insurance, and admin logistics
  • Coordinate with household support


3. Event Coordination (Masterminds)

  • Coordinate venues, food, and activities
  • Manage communication with clients, vendors, and speakers
  • Support on-site execution (when applicable)
  • Maintain event systems and checklists


  • 4. Team & HR Support
  • Support team communication and culture
  • Track reports, scorecards, and metrics
  • Coordinate onboarding and access for new hires
  • Manage team gifts, time off, and logistics
  • Assist with hiring and screening when needed


5. Marketing & Founder Support (Light)

  • Coordinate with media team as needed
  • Support social posting or content logistics
  • Assist with podcast and PR coordination


The Ideal Candidate

You are not just organized — you are operationally sharp.


You likely:

  • Learn fast and figure things out without hand-holding
  • Are extremely organized and detail-oriented
  • Execute quickly while maintaining quality
  • Anticipate needs before being told
  • Take full ownership of outcomes
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Are tech-savvy and comfortable with tools
  • Use AI tools to increase speed and output
  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-performance environments


You are the type of person who:

Sees something messy → fixes it → systemizes it → improves it.


What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

Within your first 60–90 days:

- CEO calendar is always clean, structured, and optimized

- Communication is streamlined and proactive

- Travel and logistics run smoothly without friction

- Key projects are moving forward without bottlenecks

- Event systems are organized and ready for execution

- Core workflows are documented and improving


Why This Role Is Different

Direct access to the founder

- You’ll work side-by-side with the CEO on real decisions and execution.


High ownership, not task-taking

- You are expected to think, improve, and operate — not just follow instructions.


Massive learning curve

- You’ll see how a high-performing founder operates across business and life.


Variety + speed

- No two weeks look the same — this role touches everything.


Opportunity to grow

title: Level Designer / Environment Artist
description:
A Mobtex Softwares desenvolve softwares que trazem resultados reais para seus clientes, reduzindo custos, aumentando a produtividade dos recursos e inovando em variados segmentos de mercado. Atuamos com tecnologia, criatividade e visão de produto para construir soluções digitais e experiências interativas que geram impacto concreto.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Level Designer com forte sensibilidade visual, boa leitura da experiência do jogador e familiaridade com o novo normal do desenvolvimento de jogos com apoio de LLMs e ferramentas de IA .


Procuramos alguém que não apenas monte fases, mas que saiba transformar uma proposta de jogo em uma experiência bonita, clara, coerente e bem resolvida visualmente , usando com inteligência assets prontos, Blender, referências visuais e iteração rápida com times técnicos e criativos.


O que esperamos desse perfil
  • Criar e estruturar fases, cenas e ambientes com boa leitura espacial, ritmo e composição visual
  • Trabalhar com graybox, layout, pacing, flow e organização da experiência do jogador
  • Utilizar Blender para montagem, ajustes, otimização e adaptação de assets e cenas
  • Saber integrar e combinar assets prontos com bom gosto, consistência estética e senso de direção visual
  • Colaborar com programadores, designers e equipes de produto para transformar documentos conceituais em experiências jogáveis
  • Usar LLMs e ferramentas de IA de forma prática no fluxo de trabalho: pesquisa, documentação, breakdown de tarefas, geração de variações, refinamento de ideias e aceleração de produção
  • Ter atenção a otimização de cena , organização de arquivos, reaproveitamento inteligente de recursos e eficiência de produção
  • Participar do refinamento visual e funcional das fases, elevando a qualidade final do jogo


Requisitos
  • Experiência com level design , montagem de ambientes ou world building para jogos
  • Domínio prático de Blender para edição, adaptação, composição e otimização de assets e cenas
  • Boa noção de composição visual, escala, iluminação, leitura de cenário e clareza espacial
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com assets prontos e de marketplace sem deixar o resultado genérico ou inconsistente
  • Familiaridade com pipelines modernos de produção, incluindo uso de IA / LLMs como ferramenta de produtividade
  • Boa comunicação com equipes multidisciplinares
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com atenção a acabamento


Diferenciais
  • Experiência com Godot
  • Vivência com jogos educacionais, serious games ou experiências interativas com objetivos pedagógicos
  • Capacidade de criar props ou elementos 3D simples quando necessário
  • Noção de direção de arte, environment art ou visual development
  • Experiência com otimização para projetos multiplataforma


O que valorizamos

Valorizamos profissionais que entendam que desenvolver jogos hoje exige saber combinar visão criativa, repertório visual, ferramentas tradicionais e apoio inteligente de IA para produzir melhor, com mais velocidade, consistência e qualidade.

Buscamos alguém com bom senso estético, autonomia e vontade real de construir experiências que sejam ao mesmo tempo funcionais, bonitas e memoráveis.
