title: SAP Basis / Technical Analyst (Archiving & Support)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender um cliente global do segmento de energia, com forte atuação em projetos de tecnologia e inovação, inserido em um ambiente corporativo robusto, com operações críticas e times distribuídos globalmente. O projeto envolve sustentação e evolução de soluções SAP voltadas à gestão e arquivamento de dados, com alta exigência em performance, disponibilidade e governança da informação.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar com arquivamento de dados e documentos em SAP (ADK/AIS), incluindo execução e recuperação (PrintList, Inbound e Outbound)
  • Configurar e manter Archive InfoStructures (AIS), incluindo catálogo de campos, build/load/unload
  • Tratar falhas em jobs de arquivamento e otimizar processos de execução
  • Atuar com suporte L2/L3 em incidentes e problemas relacionados às soluções de arquivamento SAP
  • Monitorar ambiente (Datadog, scripts PowerShell), garantindo saúde, disponibilidade e performance
  • Acompanhar capacidade do ambiente (CPU, memória, disco, spool) e atuar na resolução de gargalos
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura (atualizações de aplicação, banco, sistema operacional e hardware)
  • Gerar relatórios e indicadores (KPIs) para stakeholders
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada e propor melhorias e automações
  • Atuar em conjunto com times globais na restauração de serviços e troubleshooting

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com SAP Archiving (ADK e AIS)
  • Vivência com objetos de arquivamento (FI_DOCUMNT, SD_VBAK, CO_ITEM, entre outros)
  • Experiência com suporte L2/L3 (incident e problem management)
  • Conhecimento em administração básica de Windows Server
  • Experiência com monitoramento e automação (ex: Datadog, PowerShell)
  • Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting, análise de logs e performance
  • Experiência com jobs de housekeeping e data archiving
  • Inglês avançado para atuação em ambiente global

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimentos em SAP ILM (Retention Management e Retention Warehouse)
  • Noções de ABAP para suporte e ajustes em rotinas de arquivamento
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps e ServiceNow
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e com boa comunicação

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Desenvolvedor Fullstack Senior


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

Estamos em busca de um desenvolvedor com sólida experiência em Next.js e React, além de conhecimentos em WordPress.

É fundamental ter domínio sobre boas práticas de programação, incluindo clean code, revisão de código (code review) e desenvolvimento orientado à qualidade.

Proficiência em JavaScript e TypeScript é essencial, assim como conhecimento em HTML, CSS e frameworks de estilização como Tailwind CSS ou similares.

Experiência com SSR e SSG, além de otimização de performance web e consumo de APIs REST, é requerida.

A familiaridade com Git para versionamento de código é indispensável.

Valorizamos também boa comunicação, organização e trabalho em equipe.


Requisitos Desejáveis

Experiência com outras bibliotecas de JavaScript e frameworks além de React será um diferencial. Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis é desejável, assim como familiaridade com ferramentas de deploy automatizado e integração contínua (CI/CD).

Vivência em otimização de SEO e aplicação de boas práticas de segurança web também será considerada um diferencial. Experiência adicional com DevOps ou Docker será um plus.


Resumo dos requisitos:

Next.js, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, SSR, SSG, APIs REST, Git, WordPress, clean code, code review, boas práticas de programação.

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP SR (DBT e ETL)
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Estamos buscando um Engenheiro de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Migração de Dados OnPrem para Google Cloud Platform (GCP) no setor financeiro. Esse profissional será responsável pela construção, otimização e orquestração de pipelines de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, eficiência e governança durante o processo de migração.


Descrição do Cargo:

O Engenheiro de Dados GCP Sênior será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Looker, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery) , garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

title: Senior AI Technical Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior AI Technical Project Manager .


In this role you will:

Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-powered digital initiatives across Quality and CMC operations. This role will drive cross-functional execution of AI use cases, ensuring alignment between Digital, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, and Data Science teams.

The AI TPM will be responsible for translating business needs into scalable, compliant AI solutions while managing technical dependencies, governance, risk, and value realization in a regulated (GxP) environment.

  • Lead complex AI programs from ideation through deployment and scaling.
  • Develop and manage program roadmaps, milestones, risks, and KPIs.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Data Science, IT, Quality, Manufacturing, Vendors).
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise digital and AI strategy.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define high-value AI use cases (e.g., deviations, CAPA prediction, batch analytics, document intelligence).
  • Oversee model development lifecycle (data readiness, training, validation, deployment).
  • Ensure AI solutions are scalable, secure, and production-ready.
  • Governance & Compliance (GxP Focus)Embed AI governance frameworks (model validation, explainability, bias monitoring).
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, GAMP5, CSA).
  • Drive documentation for audit readiness and inspection preparedness.
  • Manage data integrity standards (ALCOA+).
  • Understand system architecture (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, data platforms).
  • Manage integration dependencies across enterprise systems. Partner with cloud, cybersecurity, and infrastructure teams.
  • Oversee vendor technical performance.
  • Identify technical and regulatory risks early and drive mitigation.
  • Manage change adoption within Quality and CMC functions.
  • Develop communication plans for executive and operational stakeholders.
  • Define measurable KPIs (cycle time reduction, deviation reduction, automation rate).
  • Track ROI and business impact of AI initiatives.
  • Ensure sustainable scaling of successful pilots.


We have some requirements:

  • Previous experience in Technical Program Management, Digital Transformation, or Engineering Program Delivery.
  • Previous experience leading AI/ML or advanced analytics initiatives.
  • Experience in regulated industries (Pharma, Biotech, Medical Devices).
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML lifecycle and data governance.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms (LIMS, MES, SAP, Veeva, etc.).
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
  • Fluent English

description:

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);

  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;

  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Outbound Call Center Operator (Customer Care) – HVAC Industry  Remote Position – Based in Brazil | Serving U.S. Customers
description:
Role Summary


We are seeking motivated Outbound Call Center Operators to support our HVAC service operations in the United States. This role focuses on proactive customer outreach, scheduling preventive maintenance appointments and safety inspections for homeowners.


The primary goal of this position is to generate service demand and maintain a steady flow of scheduled appointments for field technicians. By contacting existing and past customers, the operator helps prevent equipment breakdowns and ensures customers receive reliable comfort in their homes.


Success in this role means consistently scheduling maintenance visits, delivering a positive customer experience, and maintaining accurate CRM records. This position is an important part of the company's customer care and service operations, directly supporting the productivity of field technicians.


Responsibilities


• Make outbound calls to customers in the company database to schedule HVAC maintenance visits and inspections.


• Contact different customer groups including Comfort Club members, inactive customers, and new prospects.


• Present the company’s preventive maintenance offers and service guarantees clearly and professionally.


• Schedule appointments for HVAC tune-ups and inspections according to technician availability.


• Conduct customer satisfaction follow-up calls (\"Happy Calls\") after service visits.


• Record call outcomes, customer information, and appointment details in the CRM system.


• Follow company call scripts and communication guidelines to maintain consistency and professionalism.


• Maintain productivity targets related to calls made and appointments scheduled.


• Coordinate with the scheduling and dispatch teams when necessary to ensure accurate appointment management.


• Maintain a positive and professional tone during all customer interactions.


Qualifications

Skills


• Fluent English communication skills (spoken and written).

• Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.

• Ability to handle rejection and maintain a positive attitude during outbound calls.

• Strong organization and time management skills.

• Comfortable using computers, CRM systems, and scheduling tools.

• Fast and accurate typing skills.


Experience


• Previous experience in customer service, sales, telemarketing, or call center environments is preferred.


• Experience with outbound calling or appointment setting is a strong advantage.


• Experience working with U.S. customers or international support teams is a plus.


Work Requirements


• Quiet and professional home office environment.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection.

• Ability to work during U.S. business hours.

• Strong focus and discipline during outbound calling periods.

title: CX Designer
description:
Buscamos um(a) CX Designer com sólida experiência em gestão e aprimoramento da experiência do cliente, capaz de analisar jornadas complexas, identificar oportunidades estratégicas e propor soluções que elevem a percepção de valor da marca. O(a) profissional atuará de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas, garantindo coerência, qualidade e eficiência em todas as interações ao longo da jornada do cliente. Procuramos alguém analítico(a), organizado(a) e orientado(a) a resultados, com foco na tomada de decisão baseada em dados e na melhoria contínua.



Responsabilidades :


  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar jornadas do cliente, identificando pontos críticos, melhorias e oportunidades de inovação;
  • Conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas para obtenção de insights sobre comportamentos, necessidades e expectativas dos clientes;
  • Desenvolver e manter artefatos de CX, como personas, mapas de empatia, blueprints de serviço e fluxos de interação;
  • Colaborar com áreas internas (Produto, Marketing, Atendimento, Operações e Tecnologia) para garantir consistência e excelência na experiência do cliente;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Voice of Customer (VoC), incluindo análise de NPS, CSAT, CES e demais indicadores estratégicos;
  • Facilitar workshops, sessões de co-criação e dinâmicas de alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Propor soluções orientadas por dados, visando satisfação, retenção e fidelização.


Requisitos:


Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência prévia como CX Designer, Service Designer, UX Researcher ou funções correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de Design Thinking, Service Design e técnicas de pesquisa com usuários;
  • Habilidade em estruturar informações, traduzir insights em ações práticas e construir jornadas complexas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar análises e recomendações;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado à melhoria contínua.


Desejáveis:


  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Miro, Figma, Notion, Jira ou equivalentes;
  • Conhecimento de métricas de experiência (NPS, CSAT, CES);
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Elite Executive Assistant to CEO For U.S. Online Brand

Full-Time | Remote | Working U.S. Central Hours | Work Directly with the Founder


We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to Austin Netzley, CEO of 2X.


This is not a typical assistant role.


This is for someone who wants to operate as a true right hand to a founder — helping build, organize, and execute across both business and life.


If you love systems, execution, speed, and turning chaos into clarity, this role will be incredibly rewarding.


About 2X &

At 2X (2X.co), we help founders scale their businesses while getting their time back. We have coaching programs, online community, and in-person events. 


At , we help small businesses implement the proven systems and strategies to optimize their team and operations so they can scale faster with more freedom. 


We focus on building businesses that:

- Run on systems (not the founder)

- Scale with more profit and less complexity

- Create real freedom and long-term value


We move fast, operate at a high standard, and care deeply about doing meaningful work that impacts entrepreneurs and their families. 


The Mission of This Role

Your mission is simple:


Protect and free up the CEO’s time as a right hand partner to help handle a lot of the details and tasks that can bog him down. 


You will operate as a leverage multiplier — ensuring the right things get done, at the right time, with high quality.


This role is about ownership, anticipation, and execution… with a strong attention to detail, a love for systems, producing efficiently, and being able to wear numerous hats with different tasks and responsibilities. 


The Outcomes You Own

This role is responsible for ensuring:


1. CEO Time is Protected and Optimized

Calendar reflects true priorities, not noise.


2. Communication is Clean and Controlled

Email, Slack, and external communication are organized, timely, and proactive.


3. Projects Move Without Bottlenecks

Key initiatives progress quickly without the CEO needing to follow up.


4. Personal + Business Logistics Run Seamlessly

Travel, scheduling, events, and life logistics are handled smoothly.


5. Events Are Executed at a High Level

Masterminds and experiences are well-organized and on-brand.


6. The Team Stays Aligned and Supported

Basic HR, onboarding, and internal coordination run cleanly.


7. Systems Are Built (Not Just Tasks Completed)

Work becomes organized, repeatable, and scalable over time.


Core Responsibilities


1. Executive Support (Business)

  • Own email + communication flow
  • Manage calendar with strong prioritization
  • Coordinate business travel and logistics
  • Conduct research and prep materials
  • Support slides, docs, and key initiatives
  • Maintain ClickUp task organization


2. Personal Support

  • Plan and coordinate personal travel
  • Schedule personal appointments and events
  • Manage gifts and special occasions
  • Handle health, insurance, and admin logistics
  • Coordinate with household support


3. Event Coordination (Masterminds)

  • Coordinate venues, food, and activities
  • Manage communication with clients, vendors, and speakers
  • Support on-site execution (when applicable)
  • Maintain event systems and checklists


  • 4. Team & HR Support
  • Support team communication and culture
  • Track reports, scorecards, and metrics
  • Coordinate onboarding and access for new hires
  • Manage team gifts, time off, and logistics
  • Assist with hiring and screening when needed


5. Marketing & Founder Support (Light)

  • Coordinate with media team as needed
  • Support social posting or content logistics
  • Assist with podcast and PR coordination


The Ideal Candidate

You are not just organized — you are operationally sharp.


You likely:

  • Learn fast and figure things out without hand-holding
  • Are extremely organized and detail-oriented
  • Execute quickly while maintaining quality
  • Anticipate needs before being told
  • Take full ownership of outcomes
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Are tech-savvy and comfortable with tools
  • Use AI tools to increase speed and output
  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-performance environments


You are the type of person who:

Sees something messy → fixes it → systemizes it → improves it.


What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

Within your first 60–90 days:

- CEO calendar is always clean, structured, and optimized

- Communication is streamlined and proactive

- Travel and logistics run smoothly without friction

- Key projects are moving forward without bottlenecks

- Event systems are organized and ready for execution

- Core workflows are documented and improving


Why This Role Is Different

Direct access to the founder

- You’ll work side-by-side with the CEO on real decisions and execution.


High ownership, not task-taking

- You are expected to think, improve, and operate — not just follow instructions.


Massive learning curve

- You’ll see how a high-performing founder operates across business and life.


Variety + speed

- No two weeks look the same — this role touches everything.


Opportunity to grow


Logistics

  • Location: Remote position
  • Hours: 40 hours/week
  • Compensation: based on experience and skills 


We are looking for a long-term fit only. There will be numerous opportunities to advance into other roles if you desire, but this EA role is ideally a long-term position for you.


How to Apply

If you’re someone who wants to operate as a true right hand — and take ownership in a fast-moving environment — we’d love to hear from you.


Apply with:

  • Your resume
  • A short paragraph or few lines on why this role excites you
  • Your email address 


We’ll then review and be in touch!

title: Customer Success Coordinator/Account Manager
description:
Company Description

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology. As we scale our platform, strong delivery discipline and cross-functional coordination are critical.


Headshots.com is seeking a Customer Success Coordinator to support post-launch customer engagement, account coordination, and internal systems upkeep. This role helps ensure a smooth, high-quality experience for customers through consistent execution and strong coordination across teams.


The ideal candidate brings a high level of organization, reliability, and comfort working at the intersection of customer communication, systems accuracy, and cross-functional team collaboration.


Core Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Account Support

  • Conduct monthly check-ins with launched teams to maintain engagement, gather feedback, and surface potential expansion or upsell opportunities.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned team accounts after launch, handling questions, updates, and general account support.
  • Escalate complex issues or commercial conversations to senior leadership as needed.

Training & Enablement Support

  • Lead or co-lead admin and team training sessions on how to submit usable photos (lighting, framing, attire, common errors).
  • Manage live Q&A during trainings using prepared materials and documented best practices.
  • Capture recurring questions and feedback to improve documentation and training assets over time.

Account Management & Operational Advocacy

  • Serve as a coordination point across Customer Success, Production, and internal teams to ensure customer uploads and deliverables move smoothly through established workflows.
  • Maintain regular update cadences and ensure files, approvals, and records are accurately tracked and archived.
  • Act as an advocate for both customers and internal teams by identifying process gaps, reducing friction, and surfacing opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define requirements and support the transition from manual tracking to more scalable, automated systems over time.


CRM & Data Hygiene (Pipedrive)

  • Keep Pipedrive records current for organizations and deals, ensuring required fields are completed for reporting, visibility, and handoffs.
  • Flag repeat manual work that should be automated and document requirements clearly for Dev.


Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal English language skills
  • 3+ years in customer success, operations, or administrative support.
  • 2+ years of sales experience.
  • Strong written communication and customer-facing professionalism.
  • Experience working with CRMs (Pipedrive, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Comfortable coordinating across Customer Success, Production, Sales, and Dev.
  • Highly organized, dependable, and able to follow recurring cadences.


Preferred

  • Experience running customer trainings or onboarding sessions.
  • Familiarity with SaaS-style account management or subscription services.
  • Process documentation or SOP experience.


Why This Role Matters

This position is not just support—it is a force multiplier. By owning recurring customer and data workflows, this role directly enables Headshots.com to scale accounts, improve retention, and transition from manual effort to system-driven growth.


IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

title: Especialista IA
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Modelo de trabalho: remoto


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Design e Desenvolvimento de Agentes IA: Criar e implementar agentes autônomos que possam interagir de forma eficiente com os usuários e com outros sistemas.
  • Integração de LLMs: Trabalhar na integração de Modelos de Linguagem Grandes, otimizando seu uso para melhorar a experiência do usuário.
  • Otimização de Fluxos de Interação: Desenvolver e otimizar fluxos complexos de interação, assegurando que os agentes operem de maneira eficaz em diferentes cenários.
  • Definição de Boas Práticas: Estabelecer e documentar boas práticas de desenvolvimento para garantir a qualidade e a escalabilidade das soluções de IA.
  • Colaboração com Equipes Multifuncionais: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de produto, design e engenharia para alinhar as soluções de IA às necessidades do negócio.
  • Monitoramento e Manutenção: Implementar estratégias de monitoramento e manutenção para garantir a performance contínua dos sistemas de IA.
  • Mentoria e Capacitação: Atuar como mentor para outros membros da equipe, promovendo o aprendizado e a adoção de novas tecnologias e métodos.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de IA e sistemas relacionados.
  • LLMs e NLP: Profundo conhecimento em Modelos de Linguagem Grandes, Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP), técnicas de fine-tuning e estratégias de otimização de prompts (prompt engineering).
  • Frameworks de Agentes: Proficiência avançada em LangChain/LangGraph para construção de agentes complexos e cadeias de prompts.
  • Programação: Domínio de Python e suas principais bibliotecas de IA, como Hugging Face, TensorFlow e PyTorch.
  • Integração e APIs: Vasta experiência na construção e consumo de APIs REST para integrar o agente com múltiplos sistemas, seguindo o padrão MCP (Model-Controller-Presenter).
  • Infraestrutura de IA: Familiaridade com práticas de MLOps, utilização de contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes) e ambientes de nuvem como AWS, GCP ou Azure.


Informações adicionais:

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno
description:
Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno


*Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


*O que você precisa ter

Requisitos mandatórios

• Formação concluída preferencialmente na área de TI;

• Vivências anteriores como desenvolvedor ABAP para SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA;

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de objetos RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms);

• Vivência em análise e depuração (debugging) de programas ABAP;

• Conhecimento da linguagem de programação ABAP e ABAP Orientado a Objetos;

• Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento ABAP (SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37, Eclipse com ADT);

• Conhecimento em Dicionário de Dados ABAP (DDIC);

• Experiência com técnicas de enhancement (User-Exits, Customer-Exits, BADIs, Enhancement Spots);

• Habilidade com desenvolvimento de relatórios (ALV Grid/Tree);

• Familiaridade com a criação de formulários (SmartForms e/ou Adobe Forms);

• Noções de performance tuning em ABAP.


Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais):

• Experiência com desenvolvimento em SAP S/4HANA (CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, ABAP RAP);

• Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de interfaces (IDocs, Proxies, RFCs, Web Services);

• Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5;

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

• Conhecimento em módulos funcionais SAP (ex: SD, MM, FI, CO) para melhor entendimento dos requisitos.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (relatórios, interfaces, conversões, enhancements, formulários - RICEF) no ambiente SAP S/4HANA, seguindo as especificações funcionais e técnicas;

• Realizar correções de bugs, otimizações de performance e ajustes em códigos ABAP existentes (código Z), aplicando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e garantindo a qualidade do código;

• Analisar especificações funcionais e técnicas para propor as melhores soluções de desenvolvimento ABAP;

• Criar e executar testes unitários e integrados para garantir a qualidade e a robustez das entregas de software;

• Aplicar metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e as ferramentas de gestão de código e versionamento utilizadas pelo Grupo Sipal;

• Colaborar ativamente com analistas funcionais, outros desenvolvedores e áreas de negócio para entender os requisitos e entregar soluções que agreguem valor;

• Manter a documentação técnica dos desenvolvimentos clara, completa e atualizada;

• Participar de revisões de código (code review) e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos padrões de desenvolvimento da equipe;

• Prestar suporte técnico Nível 3 para incidentes complexos que exijam análise aprofundada de código ABAP, identificando e implementando soluções eficazes;

• Pesquisar e se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e abordagens de desenvolvimento no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA (ex: ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, OData).


*Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE:

Beyondsoft Consulting, Inc. is a leading technical solutions and consulting partner. We combine emerging technologies and proven methodologies to tailor elegant solutions that solve complex challenges and empower our customers to accelerate their business goals. For the past 25+ years we have been providing a broad range of high-quality IT services, including staff augmentation, business process outsourcing, custom software solutions, test automation, digital enablement, and other software engineering and digital transformation services.


WHAT WE’RE ABOUT:

We believe that collaboration, transparency, and accountability are the values that guide our business, our delivery, and our brand. Everyone has something to bring to the table, and we believe in working together with our peers and clients to leverage the best of one another in everything we do. When we proactively collaborate, business decisions become easier, innovation is greater, and outcomes are better.


Our ability to achieve our mission and live out our values depends upon a diverse, equitable, and inclusive culture. So, we strive to foster a workplace where people have the respect, support, and voice they deserve, where innovative ideas flourish, and where people can unleash their brilliance. For more information regarding DEI at Beyondsoft, please go to


ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENT FOR REMOTE POSITIONS:

For remote positions, all candidates must complete a video screen with our corporate recruiting team.


POSITION SUMMARY:

We are looking for skilled developers and data analysts, has developed numerous tools and systems which assist in data collection, analysis, monitoring, alerting, functionality enhancement, and debugging & verification, ensuring high data quality.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

  • Maintain automated data onboarding and diagnostic tools for AIP partners
  • Monitor ADF pipelines and mitigate pipeline runs as needed
  • Maintain Privacy Dashboard and Bing user interests for Bing Growth team usage
  • Participate and resolve live sites in related areas
  • Data Platform development and maintenance, Notebook based processing pipelines and MT migration
  • Manage the regular data quality Cosmos/MT jobs
  • Online tooling and support such as DADT tools
  • Watch out the abnormal pattern, perform ad-hoc data quality analysis, investigate daily the user ad click broken cases



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science or a related field.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software development.
  • Good quality software development and understanding.
  • Ability to quickly communicate across time zones.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Self-motivated
  • Coding Language: C#, Python, Scala, Java,
  • Technologies: Apache Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Hadoop, Cosmos, Scope SQL, MVC
  • Azure resource management: ADF, Azure Key vaults, Managed Identity, Azure Storage, etc.
  • Big data experience is a plus



WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER:

Because we know how important our people are to the success of our clients, it’s a priority to make sure we stay committed to our employees and making Beyondsoft a great place to work. We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits along with a company culture that embodies continuous learning, growth, and training with a dedicated focus on employee satisfaction and work/life balance.


Beyondsoft provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regards to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, and the full employee lifecycle up through and including termination.

title: Product Manager - B2B | Câmbio / FX
description:
Sua carreira com liberdade e propósito

Na Remessa Online, não se trata apenas de transferências internacionais, criamos conexões que rompem fronteiras e transformam realidades. Somos movidos pela ousadia, respeito, colaboração, encantamento e responsabilidade.

Nosso segredo? Trabalhar juntos com transparência, comprometimento e autonomia, sempre buscando a melhor solução. Estamos revolucionando o cenário financeiro global, e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!


Como vai ser o seu dia a dia

Buscamos um(a) Product Manager estratégico, analítico e comunicativo, capaz de conectar produto, tecnologia e negócio para impulsionar nossas soluções. Esperamos alguém que tenha uma execução ágil e organizada, garantindo qualidade e rapidez, além de autonomia para conduzir upstream e gerenciar o backlog sem necessidade de direcionamento constante. E que possua forte capacidade analítica para tomar decisões embasadas, comunicação clara para alinhar stakeholders e um sólido senso de responsabilidade e equilíbrio na tomada de decisões.

  • Experiência com descoberta e desenvolvimento de produtos;
  • Domínio de métricas, KPIs e análise de dados para tomada de decisão;
  • Capacidade de priorizar backlog e rodar sprints com eficiência;
  • Conhecimento de estratégia de produto e roadmap;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão como JIRA, Kanbanize e Confluence;
  • Noção de tecnologia e APIs para dialogar bem com times de engenharia;
  • Experiência em produtos financeiros, especialmente câmbio;
  • Histórico de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos e de alto crescimento;
  • Habilidade em negociação e influência para conectar áreas e garantir entregas estratégicas;
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência como Product Manager.


O que você precisa saber para se juntar ao nosso time

  • Experiência com setor de câmbio;
  • Atuar na plataforma Web PJ, que já existe, mas precisa de mais atração e engajamento;
  • Foco em aquisição, recorrência e fidelização de clientes PJ;
  • Explorar e fortalecer soluções para diferentes perfis de empresa (desde o \"PJtinha\" até grandes como Comex);
  • Conhecer bem a operação da Remessa para propor melhorias reais;
  • Enfrentar concorrência forte com diferenciais frente a players concorrentes da Remessa;
  • Ter visão de toda a jornada e ciclo de vida do cliente PJ;
  • Apoiar no crescimento da base com experiência em aquisição de clientes e produtos de plataforma.


O que oferecemos

  • Contrato CLT – Todos os direitos garantidos.
  • Bônus por metas – Recebimento de bônus atrelado ao cumprimento de objetivos organizacionais.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico – Cobertura para você e seus dependentes via SulAmérica.
  • VR e VA flexíveis – Créditos no Caju para usar como quiser.
  • Auxílio Home Office – Suporte para despesas e equipamentos.
  • Seguro de Vida – Proteção e segurança para você.
  • Auxílio Creche – Apoio para mães e pais.
  • Auxílio a dependentes com necessidades especiais – Apoio financeiro dedicado.
  • Licenças Estendidas – Maternidade e paternidade ampliadas para você aproveitar esse momento especial.
  • Descontos na Remessa Online – Para viver sem fronteiras!
  • Bem-estar e saúde – Consultas online com psicólogos e nutricionistas via Conexa Saúde e Psicologia Viva.
  • Wellhub – Acesso a academias e serviços como mindfulness, nutrição e terapia.
  • Apoio ao Empregado (EAP) – Suporte especializado sempre que precisar.
  • Day Off no Aniversário – Seu dia especial merece folga!
  • Ciclo de Desenvolvimento e Treinamentos – Desafios, capacitações e avaliação 360° para impulsionar sua carreira!

Atuação

Remoto : Trabalhe de onde quiser! Se preferir um escritório, temos espaço em São Paulo. Flexibilidade é o nosso lema.


Diversidade e Inclusão: Construindo o Futuro!

Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece e nos impulsiona a ir além. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas! Queremos um ambiente onde cada voz seja ouvida, cada experiência valorizada e cada contribuição faça a diferença.

Mais do que um compromisso, essa é a nossa realidade: um lugar acolhedor, respeitoso e representativo, onde juntos construímos um futuro mais justo, inclusivo e inspirador.

Descubra mais sobre a Remessa Online

Saiba mais sobre nós no nosso site e acompanhe nosso time no LinkedIn. Confira também o que nossos colaboradores dizem sobre a empresa no Glassdoor.


Vem ser #SouRemessa e fazer parte da equipe que transforma o mundo com ousadia, colaboração e responsabilidade!

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que procuramos?

Perfil autônomo, independente e proativo , com responsabilidade sobre as soluções do início ao fim. Experiência sólida com Node.js, JavaScript e TypeScript , além de conhecimento em Java com Springboot .


O que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência em Node.js / JavaScript / TypeScript.
  • Conhecimento em Springboot / Java.
  • Familiaridade com microserviços.
  • Habilidade em gerenciamento de APIs e MQ.
  • Experiência com MongoDB.
  • Conhecimento em Oracle / PL/SQL.
  • Práticas de DevOps.
  • Experiência com OpenShift / Kubernetes (k8s).
  • Conhecimento em Cloud Azure.


Será um diferencial:

  • Capacidade de desenhar arquitetura sistêmica.
  • Agnóstico a tecnologia e linguagem de programação, pois entendemos que sabendo os conceitos, não importa a ferramenta utilizada.
  • Já construiu ambientes e entendesse de conceitos de rede e protocolos de comunicação.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tunning de aplicações.
  • Escrevesse em linguagem de script.
  • Já trabalhou com Metodologia Ágil.
  • Incessante na aprendizagem.


O que você fará no seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolvimento de Soluções: Evoluir e otimizar soluções existentes, sempre garantindo alta escalabilidade e desempenho.
  • Qualidade de Código: Implementar e promover práticas de testes rigorosos para assegurar a qualidade do software.
  • Colaboração em Requisitos: Trabalhar diretamente com usuários para compreender e documentar requisitos, e colaborar com a equipe no processo de implementação, desde o código até a produção.
  • Investigação de Problemas: Auxiliar na análise e resolução de falhas potenciais em sistemas e processos, garantindo a estabilidade e a eficácia da operação.
  • Automação de Processos: Automatizar rotinas e processos, assegurando que sejam resilientes e eficientes.


Local de atuação? No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT

Type: Contract

Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries)

Rate: DOE


Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

Key Details:

• Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack

• Experience: 7–10 years

• Interview Process: 2 rounds

• Requirements: Immediate

• Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time


Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.’

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:


● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

title: Analista de QA Pleno
description:
Analista de QA Pleno


Modelo de Contratação: PJ

Modelo de Trabalho: 100% remoto


Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) profissional de QA para atuar na validação da qualidade de aplicações web e APIs, garantindo que as entregas atendam aos requisitos funcionais e técnicos definidos.

A pessoa terá papel importante na definição de estratégias de teste, desenvolvimento de automações e colaboração com o time de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para prevenir falhas e elevar o padrão das entregas.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, criar e executar casos de teste funcionais, regressivos, exploratórios e de integração;
  • Garantir a qualidade das aplicações web e APIs, atuando de forma preventiva desde o início do desenvolvimento;
  • Validar regras de negócio, fluxos críticos e cenários de borda com alto nível de critério e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Reproduzir bugs reportados, documentando cenários, evidências e passos para reprodução de forma clara e objetiva.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir testes automatizados para aplicações web e APIs;
  • Apoiar na definição da estratégia de automação, priorizando testes que gerem maior valor;
  • Integrar automações aos pipelines de CI/CD, contribuindo para entregas mais seguras e confiáveis;
  • Participar ativamente de refinamentos, reviews e discussões técnicas, contribuindo com o olhar de qualidade;
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na prevenção de falhas e melhoria contínua dos processos.
  • Documentar planos de teste, cenários automatizados, padrões e boas práticas de QA;
  • Sugerir melhorias nos processos de testes, qualidade e desenvolvimento;
  • Atuar como guardião(a) da qualidade, questionando, validando e elevando o padrão das entregas.


Requisitos

  • Conhecimentos de técnicas de teste de software (funcional, regressão, etc.).
  • Conhecimentos de ferramentas de automação de testes.
  • Conhecimentos de metodologias ágeis e de desenvolvimento de software.


Perfil Desejado

  • Perfil analítico e organizado
  • Proatividade para aprender
  • Boa comunicação para interação com diferentes áreas

title: AI Automations Engineer
description:
About Evvolve & Partners

Evvolve & Partners connects a select group of founders and investors through our private network, Evvolve Circle. With $2B+ in completed transactions and relationships with 305+ family offices globally, we facilitate highly curated introductions in the private markets.


You can learn more about our platform and .


The Role

We are hiring an AI Automation Engineer to help build and own the internal automation systems that power our deal flow and investor engagement.


This role sits at the intersection of operations, data, and AI-driven workflows. You will be responsible for designing and maintaining complex automation processes that connect our core systems, structure internal data, and support communication with investors and founders. You will play a key role in building scalable workflows that improve operational efficiency and ensure reliable information flow across our platform.


Responsibilities

  • Design and manage multi-step automation workflows using n8n to support internal operations
  • Build systems that connect and synchronize data across Supabase, Attio, and Airtable
  • Develop structured workflows that process operational data, generate internal reports, and support activity tracking
  • Implement AI-supported workflows that process unstructured inputs into structured outputs
  • Ensure reliability across workflows through testing, monitoring, and error-handling logic
  • Continuously identify opportunities to automate internal processes and improve operational efficiency


Profile

  • 2–4 years experience in automation engineering, workflow architecture, or low-code development
  • Strong experience building workflows in n8n or similar platforms (Make, Zapier, Retool, etc.)
  • Comfortable working with APIs, JSON data structures, and workflow logic
  • Experience working with databases and writing SQL queries (Supabase/PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Familiarity with integrating AI APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic within automated workflows
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on building reliable, scalable systems
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to take ownership of internal tooling and automation


Why Evvolve?

  • Direct exposure to senior management and the opportunity to contribute to core operational systems
  • A lean, merit-based environment where strong work and initiative are quickly recognized
  • A fast-paced, fully remote team focused on building efficient, high-impact internal tools

title: SAP Basis / Technical Analyst (Archiving & Support)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender um cliente global do segmento de energia, com forte atuação em projetos de tecnologia e inovação, inserido em um ambiente corporativo robusto, com operações críticas e times distribuídos globalmente. O projeto envolve sustentação e evolução de soluções SAP voltadas à gestão e arquivamento de dados, com alta exigência em performance, disponibilidade e governança da informação.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar com arquivamento de dados e documentos em SAP (ADK/AIS), incluindo execução e recuperação (PrintList, Inbound e Outbound)
  • Configurar e manter Archive InfoStructures (AIS), incluindo catálogo de campos, build/load/unload
  • Tratar falhas em jobs de arquivamento e otimizar processos de execução
  • Atuar com suporte L2/L3 em incidentes e problemas relacionados às soluções de arquivamento SAP
  • Monitorar ambiente (Datadog, scripts PowerShell), garantindo saúde, disponibilidade e performance
  • Acompanhar capacidade do ambiente (CPU, memória, disco, spool) e atuar na resolução de gargalos
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura (atualizações de aplicação, banco, sistema operacional e hardware)
  • Gerar relatórios e indicadores (KPIs) para stakeholders
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada e propor melhorias e automações
  • Atuar em conjunto com times globais na restauração de serviços e troubleshooting

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com SAP Archiving (ADK e AIS)
  • Vivência com objetos de arquivamento (FI_DOCUMNT, SD_VBAK, CO_ITEM, entre outros)
  • Experiência com suporte L2/L3 (incident e problem management)
  • Conhecimento em administração básica de Windows Server
  • Experiência com monitoramento e automação (ex: Datadog, PowerShell)
  • Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting, análise de logs e performance
  • Experiência com jobs de housekeeping e data archiving
  • Inglês avançado para atuação em ambiente global

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimentos em SAP ILM (Retention Management e Retention Warehouse)
  • Noções de ABAP para suporte e ajustes em rotinas de arquivamento
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps e ServiceNow
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e com boa comunicação

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

description:

Job Summary:

Objective:

Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert.

• Interview Process: 2 rounds

• Requirements: Immediate

• Candidate has to work in CST OR EST time


Key Responsibilities:

● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms.

● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations.

● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack.

● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents.

● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence.

● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency.

● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities.

● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs.

● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions.

● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization.

Scheduling:

● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week.

● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution.

● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration.

● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.

● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization.

● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges.

● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management.

● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.’

● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs.

● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes.

Preferred Qualifications:

One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage:

Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management).

Communication & Attitude:


● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly.

● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude.

● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.
