title: Executive Assistant
description:
Elite Executive Assistant to CEO For U.S. Online Brand

Full-Time | Remote | Working U.S. Central Hours | Work Directly with the Founder


We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to Austin Netzley, CEO of 2X.


This is not a typical assistant role.


This is for someone who wants to operate as a true right hand to a founder — helping build, organize, and execute across both business and life.


If you love systems, execution, speed, and turning chaos into clarity, this role will be incredibly rewarding.


About 2X &

At 2X (2X.co), we help founders scale their businesses while getting their time back. We have coaching programs, online community, and in-person events. 


At , we help small businesses implement the proven systems and strategies to optimize their team and operations so they can scale faster with more freedom. 


We focus on building businesses that:

- Run on systems (not the founder)

- Scale with more profit and less complexity

- Create real freedom and long-term value


We move fast, operate at a high standard, and care deeply about doing meaningful work that impacts entrepreneurs and their families. 


The Mission of This Role

Your mission is simple:


Protect and free up the CEO’s time as a right hand partner to help handle a lot of the details and tasks that can bog him down. 


You will operate as a leverage multiplier — ensuring the right things get done, at the right time, with high quality.


This role is about ownership, anticipation, and execution… with a strong attention to detail, a love for systems, producing efficiently, and being able to wear numerous hats with different tasks and responsibilities. 


The Outcomes You Own

This role is responsible for ensuring:


1. CEO Time is Protected and Optimized

Calendar reflects true priorities, not noise.


2. Communication is Clean and Controlled

Email, Slack, and external communication are organized, timely, and proactive.


3. Projects Move Without Bottlenecks

Key initiatives progress quickly without the CEO needing to follow up.


4. Personal + Business Logistics Run Seamlessly

Travel, scheduling, events, and life logistics are handled smoothly.


5. Events Are Executed at a High Level

Masterminds and experiences are well-organized and on-brand.


6. The Team Stays Aligned and Supported

Basic HR, onboarding, and internal coordination run cleanly.


7. Systems Are Built (Not Just Tasks Completed)

Work becomes organized, repeatable, and scalable over time.


Core Responsibilities


1. Executive Support (Business)

  • Own email + communication flow
  • Manage calendar with strong prioritization
  • Coordinate business travel and logistics
  • Conduct research and prep materials
  • Support slides, docs, and key initiatives
  • Maintain ClickUp task organization


2. Personal Support

  • Plan and coordinate personal travel
  • Schedule personal appointments and events
  • Manage gifts and special occasions
  • Handle health, insurance, and admin logistics
  • Coordinate with household support


3. Event Coordination (Masterminds)

  • Coordinate venues, food, and activities
  • Manage communication with clients, vendors, and speakers
  • Support on-site execution (when applicable)
  • Maintain event systems and checklists


  • 4. Team & HR Support
  • Support team communication and culture
  • Track reports, scorecards, and metrics
  • Coordinate onboarding and access for new hires
  • Manage team gifts, time off, and logistics
  • Assist with hiring and screening when needed


5. Marketing & Founder Support (Light)

  • Coordinate with media team as needed
  • Support social posting or content logistics
  • Assist with podcast and PR coordination


The Ideal Candidate

You are not just organized — you are operationally sharp.


You likely:

  • Learn fast and figure things out without hand-holding
  • Are extremely organized and detail-oriented
  • Execute quickly while maintaining quality
  • Anticipate needs before being told
  • Take full ownership of outcomes
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Are tech-savvy and comfortable with tools
  • Use AI tools to increase speed and output
  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-performance environments


You are the type of person who:

Sees something messy → fixes it → systemizes it → improves it.


What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

Within your first 60–90 days:

- CEO calendar is always clean, structured, and optimized

- Communication is streamlined and proactive

- Travel and logistics run smoothly without friction

- Key projects are moving forward without bottlenecks

- Event systems are organized and ready for execution

- Core workflows are documented and improving


Why This Role Is Different

Direct access to the founder

- You’ll work side-by-side with the CEO on real decisions and execution.


High ownership, not task-taking

- You are expected to think, improve, and operate — not just follow instructions.


Massive learning curve

- You’ll see how a high-performing founder operates across business and life.


Variety + speed

- No two weeks look the same — this role touches everything.


Opportunity to grow


Logistics

  • Location: Remote position
  • Hours: 40 hours/week
  • Compensation: based on experience and skills 


We are looking for a long-term fit only. There will be numerous opportunities to advance into other roles if you desire, but this EA role is ideally a long-term position for you.


How to Apply

If you’re someone who wants to operate as a true right hand — and take ownership in a fast-moving environment — we’d love to hear from you.


Apply with:

  • Your resume
  • A short paragraph or few lines on why this role excites you
  • Your email address 


We’ll then review and be in touch!

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Artificial Intelligence Growth Content Specialist
description:
Description

At Acendeo, we don’t just use tools; we build intelligent systems. We are looking for a Growth AI Engineer to architect the \"brain \" behind our marketing engine. Your goal is to move beyond simple \"if-this-then-that\" automation and deploy autonomous AI Agents that turn organic traffic into a predictable revenue pipeline. You will bridge the gap between high-level SEO strategy and technical execution, ensuring our growth is powered by cutting-edge Generative AI and Agentic Workflows .


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient


Responsibilities
  • Autonomous Agent Development: Design and deploy AI Agents (using n8n, LangChain, or Claude Cowork) to handle lead research, scoring, and routing.
  • Generative Content Engine: Architect systems that use LLM s to transform a single piece of core content into a multi-channel organic lead source.
  • AI-Enhanced SEO & AEO: Use AI for technical SEO and structured data optimization to ensure Acendeo is the top answer in generative search engines.
  • Intelligent Outreach: Scale cold email sequencing and LinkedIn marketing using AI to personalize messaging at a level that bypasses standard automation filters.
  • Predictable Revenue Infrastructure: Align marketing and sales systems so that AI-driven data hygiene leads to predictable revenue rather than guesswork.



Requirements
  • AI Specialization: Proven expertise in building market-ready automations and AI-assisted operations using Claude, OpenAI, and REST APIs.
  • Systems Engineering: Significant experience designing revenue infrastructure, including CRM architecture, pipeline automation, and lead scoring systems.
  • Technical SEO Mastery: Deep understanding of technical SEO, keyword research, and on-page optimization to drive non-vanity, qualified inbound traffic.
  • Advanced Tooling: High proficiency in n8n, Clay, Webflow, and CRM platforms like HubSpot or GoHighLevel.
  • Strategic Marketing Management: Ability to align marketing and sales systems so revenue growth is predictable rather than guesswork.
  • Data Hygiene & Analytics: Expertise in maintaining data integrity and utilizing performance marketing analytics (CTR, CVR, ROI) to make informed decisions.Tips: Provide a summary of the role, what success in the position looks like, and how this role fits into the organization overall.

title: Customer Support and Success Representative
description:
About Us:

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

We’re looking for a responsible, empathetic, and detail-oriented Customer Support and Success Representative to join our growing team. In this role, you will serve as the main point of contact for our customers via email, phone, and social media platforms. In addition to managing customer communications, you will help collect and manage feedback from customers to continually improve our operations. You will also support key interdepartmental company tasks to help ensure a smooth and engaging online experience.


Role Responsibilities

Customer Support:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, feedback, and support requests.
  • Provide exceptional customer experience via email, social media, and by phone.
  • Communicate with the manufacturing team to ensure customer requests are handled with quality.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for wholesale customers.


Customer Success :

  • Collect and relay customer feedback to help shape product improvements.
  • Present reports based on customer inquiries and comments received by email and phone
  • Work with the Marketing team to manage customer feedback in organized surveys
  • Monitor social media for trends and customer feedback


Digital, E-commerce, and other Operations:

  • Ensure the website is functioning correctly and troubleshoot any issues that arise.
  • Execute digital operations audits and processes
  • Manage and update various Google Sheets used for project tracking.
  • Assist interdepartmental projects 
  • Other duties as assigned 


Qualifications
  • Full fluency in both written and spoken English is required. Candidates without this qualification will not be considered for this role .
  • Associate's or Bachelor’s degree
  • A customer-first mindset
  • Previous experience in customer-facing roles with phone support is a bonus
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively
  • Attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Experience with phone support platforms such as Zendesk or CallHippo is a plus
  • Experience working with Google Sheets
  • Ability to learn quickly and a strong willingness to continuously develop new skills


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

• Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.

• Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.

• Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.

• Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.

• Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.

• Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.

• Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.

• Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.

• Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

﻿

How to Apply

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

title: Analista de testes sênior
description:
Curte garantir qualidade em sistemas que realmente fazem a operação acontecer?

Como Analista de QA, você será peça-chave na estabilidade e evolução de soluções ERP, assegurando que cada entrega funcione com precisão, performance e confiabilidade.


Aqui, qualidade não é só testar — é entender o negócio, antecipar riscos e garantir uma experiência sólida para o usuário final.


Responsabilidades

Planejar e executar testes funcionais e não funcionais em sistemas ERP

Criar e manter roteiros de testes (manuais e automatizados)

Desenvolver automações de testes utilizando Selenium

Validar integrações entre sistemas (APIs, serviços, etc.)

Executar consultas em banco de dados (SQL) para validação de dados

Identificar, documentar e acompanhar bugs até a resolução

Atuar próximo ao time de desenvolvimento e produto

Participar de refinamentos, garantindo critérios de aceite claros

Contribuir para melhoria contínua da qualidade e processos

✅ Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência como QA/Testes em sistemas ERP ou sistemas complexos

Conhecimento sólido em testes funcionais e regressivos

Experiência com Selenium (automação de testes)

Conhecimento em SQL para validação de dados

Experiência com documentação de testes e gestão de bugs

Boa comunicação com times técnicos e de negócio

⭐ Diferenciais

Experiência com testes de APIs (Postman, Insomnia, etc.)

Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)

Conhecimento em CI/CD (pipeline de testes automatizados)

Experiência com testes em sistemas financeiros ou operacionais

Noções de performance e testes de carga

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager


Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C  (exclusive membership services), B2B  (corporate travel management), and B2B2C  (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool .

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits  and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.


CX Travel Specialist (Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time)

We are looking for a CX Travel Specialist  to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidate is experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.


Main Responsibilities

• Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

• Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

• Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

• Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.


Requirements

• Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

• Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

• Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.

• Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

• Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

• Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus


Why Join Us

• Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

• Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

• Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

• Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements


bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.


Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) .
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.


Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally  as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.


Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications  and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a self-starter  ready to deliver results from day one .

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note:  Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!

title: CX Designer
description:
Buscamos um(a) CX Designer com sólida experiência em gestão e aprimoramento da experiência do cliente, capaz de analisar jornadas complexas, identificar oportunidades estratégicas e propor soluções que elevem a percepção de valor da marca. O(a) profissional atuará de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas, garantindo coerência, qualidade e eficiência em todas as interações ao longo da jornada do cliente. Procuramos alguém analítico(a), organizado(a) e orientado(a) a resultados, com foco na tomada de decisão baseada em dados e na melhoria contínua.



Responsabilidades :


  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar jornadas do cliente, identificando pontos críticos, melhorias e oportunidades de inovação;
  • Conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas para obtenção de insights sobre comportamentos, necessidades e expectativas dos clientes;
  • Desenvolver e manter artefatos de CX, como personas, mapas de empatia, blueprints de serviço e fluxos de interação;
  • Colaborar com áreas internas (Produto, Marketing, Atendimento, Operações e Tecnologia) para garantir consistência e excelência na experiência do cliente;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Voice of Customer (VoC), incluindo análise de NPS, CSAT, CES e demais indicadores estratégicos;
  • Facilitar workshops, sessões de co-criação e dinâmicas de alinhamento com stakeholders;
  • Propor soluções orientadas por dados, visando satisfação, retenção e fidelização.


Requisitos:


Obrigatórios:


  • Experiência prévia como CX Designer, Service Designer, UX Researcher ou funções correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de Design Thinking, Service Design e técnicas de pesquisa com usuários;
  • Habilidade em estruturar informações, traduzir insights em ações práticas e construir jornadas complexas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar análises e recomendações;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado à melhoria contínua.


Desejáveis:


  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Miro, Figma, Notion, Jira ou equivalentes;
  • Conhecimento de métricas de experiência (NPS, CSAT, CES);
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);Inglês intermediário ou avançado.

title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
• Remote in LATAM

title: Corporate Travel Agent
description:
Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager


Company Overview:

bTd Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. bTd operates under three innovative models: B2C  (exclusive membership services), B2B  (corporate travel management), and B2B2C  (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our bTd Corp Tool .

This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to bTd travel benefits  and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.


CX Travel Specialist (Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time)

We are looking for a CX Travel Specialist  to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidate is experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.


Main Responsibilities

• Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.

• Handle client requests, changes, and special services via WhatsApp and email.

• Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.

• Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.

• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.


Requirements

• Experience in luxury or corporate travel.

• Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level

(An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)

• Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.

• Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.

• Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages.
  • Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required.
  • Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach.
  • Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively.

• Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus


Why Join Us

• Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.

• Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.

• Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.

• Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements


bTd Travel Culture:

At bTd, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.

bTd is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside bTd, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.


Terms of Employment:

  • Employment under CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) .
  • Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek
  • Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where bTd operates.
  • This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility.
  • Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.


Compensation:

  • Competitive base salary.
  • Night shift extra hours
  • Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs.
  • Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets.
  • Health and dental insurance.
  • Food card.
  • Birthday day off.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to Head of Corporate Globally  as bTd evolves through its funding rounds.
  • Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the bTd team.


Important Note Before Applying:

Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications  and can prove it with your LinkedIn profile or updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a self-starter  ready to deliver results from day one .

Forget gaming LinkedIn algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.

Note:  Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior #998061
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que procuramos?

Perfil autônomo, independente e proativo , com responsabilidade sobre as soluções do início ao fim. Experiência em linguagens Node.js , JavaScript: (ES6+), ou TypeScript , além de conhecimento em React.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Linguagens de Programação: Node.js , JavaScript: (ES6+), TypeScript
  • Frameworks e Bibliotecas: React
  • Estilos e Layouts: HTML5, CSS3
  • Familiaridade com microserviços.
  • Habilidade em gerenciamento: de APIs e MQ.
  • Experiência com: MongoDB.


Será um diferencial:

  • Desenvolvimento Backend: NestJS
  • Conhecimentos em: Angular e Vue.js, Springboot / Java, Oracle / PL/SQL
  • Entender requisitos e propusesse soluções para melhor navegação e exibição das informações necessárias.
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquitetura sistêmica e propor melhores abordagens para as telas do sistema.
  • Agnóstico a tecnologia e linguagem de programação, pois entendemos que sabendo os conceitos, não importa a ferramenta utilizada.
  • Já trabalhou com Metodologia Ágil.


O que você fará no seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver a evolução das soluções, sempre mantendo a escalabilidade e performance
  • Promover a qualidade através de testes.
  • Colaborar na construção dos requisitos junto ao Usuário e, em conjunto com o time, implementá-los do código até a Produção.
  • Auxiliar na construção de UI/UX das soluções da Squads.


Local de atuação? No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

description:

Na Remessa Online, não se trata apenas de transferências internacionais, criamos conexões que rompem fronteiras e transformam realidades. Somos movidos pela ousadia, respeito, colaboração, encantamento e responsabilidade.

O que você precisa saber para se juntar ao nosso time

O que oferecemos

  • Contrato CLT – Todos os direitos garantidos.
  • Bônus por metas – Recebimento de bônus atrelado ao cumprimento de objetivos organizacionais.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico – Cobertura para você e seus dependentes via SulAmérica.
  • VR e VA flexíveis – Créditos no Caju para usar como quiser.
  • Auxílio Home Office – Suporte para despesas e equipamentos.
  • Seguro de Vida – Proteção e segurança para você.
  • Auxílio Creche – Apoio para mães e pais.
  • Auxílio a dependentes com necessidades especiais – Apoio financeiro dedicado.
  • Licenças Estendidas – Maternidade e paternidade ampliadas para você aproveitar esse momento especial.
  • Descontos na Remessa Online – Para viver sem fronteiras!
  • Bem-estar e saúde – Consultas online com psicólogos e nutricionistas via Conexa Saúde e Psicologia Viva.
  • Wellhub – Acesso a academias e serviços como mindfulness, nutrição e terapia.
  • Apoio ao Empregado (EAP) – Suporte especializado sempre que precisar.
  • Day Off no Aniversário – Seu dia especial merece folga!
  • Ciclo de Desenvolvimento e Treinamentos – Desafios, capacitações e avaliação 360° para impulsionar sua carreira!

Atuação

Remoto : Trabalhe de onde quiser! Se preferir um escritório, temos espaço em São Paulo. Flexibilidade é o nosso lema.


Diversidade e Inclusão: Construindo o Futuro!

Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece e nos impulsiona a ir além. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas! Queremos um ambiente onde cada voz seja ouvida, cada experiência valorizada e cada contribuição faça a diferença.

Mais do que um compromisso, essa é a nossa realidade: um lugar acolhedor, respeitoso e representativo, onde juntos construímos um futuro mais justo, inclusivo e inspirador.

title: Social Media Growth Strategist
description:
Job Title: Social Media Growth Strategist

About the Company:

Our Client is a dynamic company focused on leveraging digital platforms to drive brand engagement and growth. They specialize in creating innovative social media strategies to enhance visibility and interaction across various channels.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Social Media Growth Strategist to lead and execute high-performance growth initiatives for their Instagram presence. This role is focused on scaling audience growth through data-driven strategies, performance analysis, and systematic content experimentation. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of rapidly scaling Instagram accounts, understands platform algorithms deeply, and uses analytics, testing, and optimization to consistently drive follower growth and engagement.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute data-driven Instagram growth strategies aimed at scaling the account by 5,000+ followers per month.
  • Analyze performance metrics to continuously optimize content strategy, timing, and format.
  • Design and run content experiments (hooks, formats, topics, posting cadence) to identify scalable growth patterns.
  • Use AI tools and analytics platforms to generate insights, content ideas, and performance improvements.
  • Oversee and manage the content publishing pipeline, ensuring consistent and strategic posting.
  • Collaborate with designers, editors, and content creators to produce high-performing Reels, carousels, and short-form content.
  • Repurpose and adapt content across platforms (Instagram, X, and others) to maximize reach.
  • Monitor trends, algorithm updates, and competitive accounts to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Track KPIs and report on growth metrics, engagement rates, and audience acquisition performance.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

  • Proven experience scaling Instagram accounts with measurable results.
  • Demonstrated ability to grow accounts by 5K+ followers per month or more through organic strategies.
  • Strong understanding of Instagram algorithms, Reels optimization, virality mechanics, and audience growth tactics.
  • Experience using data and analytics to guide content and growth strategy.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI tools for ideation, research, and content production workflows.
  • Highly organized with strong execution and performance tracking skills.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience managing high-growth or influencer-level social media accounts.
  • Experience with A/B testing content strategies and viral content frameworks.
  • Background in multimedia content production or creative direction.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills when working with creative teams.

Personality:

  • Analytical and data-driven mindset.
  • Creative strategist with a strong understanding of viral content mechanics.
  • Highly proactive and results-oriented.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-growth digital environment.

Software & Tools:

  • Instagram analytics and social media scheduling platforms.
  • AI content generation tools.
  • Performance tracking and analytics tools.

Schedule:

9-5 EST

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

title: Back End Developer
description:
KoreInside is the infrastructure company for private capital markets, delivering clearing, settlement, distribution, and compliance as neutral, non-competitive infrastructure for regulated intermediaries. Architected as the DTCC-equivalent for private markets, KoreInside powers broker-dealers, ATSs, funding portals, transfer agents, banks, credit unions, and RIAs through white-label, API-first platforms. Its core infrastructure includes KoreID, an interoperable investor and issuer identity passport, and KoreChain, the first SEC-qualified blockchain for private securities, enabling scalable, compliant, and auditable private market transactions.


Description

We are looking for a PHP / Laravel/Lumen framework developer with a strong understanding of the PHP programming language. Ability to work on a vibrant and exciting global FinTech company that is building a large-scale enterprise. Working alongside experienced back-end developers as well as our design team.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in developing and maintaining cutting-edge web-based PHP applications in the Laravel framework.
  • Prepare and maintain all applications utilizing standard development tools (Github, Slack, Jira, etc.)
  • Utilize backend data services and contribute to increasing existing data services API using Lumen.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle
  • Convey all task progress, evaluations, suggestions, schedules, along with technical and process issues. 


SKILLS:

  • Laravel/Lumen PHP Framework (at least 3+ years)
  • Must have a strong knowledge of Core PHP with OOPS.
  • Experience working with 3rd Party APIs
  • Experience working with MySQL/Maria DB
  • Experience with virtualization technologies like Vagrant/Docker
  • Debug, test, and fix errors
  • Experience with NoSQL  databases such as MongoDB is a plus


Document code development and revisions

  • Using GIT for version control/change management Additional office setting requirements:
  • Work well with a hard-working team
  • Preference for high-quality coffee


REQUIREMENTS:


  • Writing and understanding object-oriented PHP 
  • Experience with Laravel Framework starting from Version 6 onwards
  • Experience with ORM Experience with Cryptographic Library such as OpenSSH
  • Experience with SQL schema design
  • Ability to learn quickly and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Open-minded to new solutions, forward-thinking and strong ability to adapt
  • Git version control workflows
  • Proficiency in design patterns such as facade, repository, observer etc.
  • REST API design
  • Software testing (PHPUnit)
  • MySQL / MariaDB profiling and query optimization


At KoreInside, we offer you

  • Work with a diverse distributed team worldwide
  • Always-on learning and development
  • Collaborative work environment
  • All the tools and supports needed to do an excellent job
  • A dynamic workplace with a great balance of hard work and fun
  • A culture of innovation and a structure in which to innovate
  • A nurturing team-oriented environment with mentorship as a key feature of the dynamic

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack PHP
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack PHP Sênior para integrar nossa equipe e atuar em projetos desafiadores.

• Desenvolvimento Back-End: o Desenvolver e manter sistemas em PHP, criando soluções escaláveis e eficientes. o Criar e gerenciar integrações com APIs Restful, garantindo a comunicação eficiente entre sistemas. o Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (principalmente MySQL) para otimizar consultas e estruturar dados. o Garantir a segurança e integridade dos dados e das transações no sistema. o Criar e implementar rotinas automatizadas e agendadas (jobs). o Implementar e gerenciar autenticação e controle de acesso de usuários. o Garantir a performance dos sistemas, fazendo ajustes de código e consultas quando necessário.


• Desenvolvimento Front-End: o Desenvolver interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS e JavaScript. o Utilizar frameworks como Bootstrap e Material Design para garantir a compatibilidade com diferentes dispositivos e navegadores. o Trabalhar com interatividade e animações usando JavaScript. o Implementar boas práticas de SEO e otimização de performance no front-end. o Integrar o front-end com o back-end, garantindo que os dados sejam exibidos corretamente para o usuário.


• WordPress: o Implementar e personalizar temas e plugins no WordPress, criando soluções sob medida conforme a necessidade do cliente. o Garantir que os sites criados sejam rápidos, seguros e responsivos. o Manter a arquitetura e estrutura do código organizada e fácil de manter.


• Controle de Versão e Colaboração: o Utilizar Git para versionamento de código e garantir o trabalho colaborativo com a equipe. o Participar de revisões de código, buscando a melhoria contínua do processo de desenvolvimento. o Colaborar com designers, analistas e outros desenvolvedores para garantir que os requisitos do projeto sejam atendidos.


• Manutenção e Melhoria Contínua: o Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva nos sistemas, corrigindo bugs e implementando melhorias conforme necessário. o Propor e implementar soluções que aumentem a eficiência e a qualidade do código. o Ajudar e orientar outros programadores da equipe quando necessário, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo.


• Segurança e Escalabilidade: o Aplicar boas práticas de segurança no desenvolvimento de sistemas, evitando vulnerabilidades como SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, entre outros. o Garantir que o sistema seja escalável e fácil de manter, com código modular e reutilizável. o Implementar sistemas de backup e recuperação de dados


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


• Sólidos conhecimentos em PHP, com experiência prática em desenvolvimento web. • Experiência com JavaScript . • Domínio de HTML5, CSS3 e frameworks como Bootstrap e Material Design para desenvolvimento front-end. • Experiência em integração de APIs Restful. • Conhecimento avançado em WordPress, incluindo customização de temas e plugins. • Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código, como Git. • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e em equipe. • Habilidade para resolver problemas de forma criativa e eficiente.


Desejável:


• Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL), WordPress, Back-End e Front-End.


O que oferecemos:


  • Vaga 100% Home Office: Trabalhe de onde estiver, com qualidade de vida.
  • Modelo de contratação: PJ
  • Ajuda de custo no valor de R$500,00 reais
  • Acesso a plataforma Alura

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Back End Developer
description:
KoreInside is the infrastructure company for private capital markets, delivering clearing, settlement, distribution, and compliance as neutral, non-competitive infrastructure for regulated intermediaries. Architected as the DTCC-equivalent for private markets, KoreInside powers broker-dealers, ATSs, funding portals, transfer agents, banks, credit unions, and RIAs through white-label, API-first platforms. Its core infrastructure includes KoreID, an interoperable investor and issuer identity passport, and KoreChain, the first SEC-qualified blockchain for private securities, enabling scalable, compliant, and auditable private market transactions.


Description

We are looking for a PHP / Laravel/Lumen framework developer with a strong understanding of the PHP programming language. Ability to work on a vibrant and exciting global FinTech company that is building a large-scale enterprise. Working alongside experienced back-end developers as well as our design team.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in developing and maintaining cutting-edge web-based PHP applications in the Laravel framework.
  • Prepare and maintain all applications utilizing standard development tools (Github, Slack, Jira, etc.)
  • Utilize backend data services and contribute to increasing existing data services API using Lumen.
  • Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle
  • Convey all task progress, evaluations, suggestions, schedules, along with technical and process issues. 


SKILLS:

  • Laravel/Lumen PHP Framework (at least 3+ years)
  • Must have a strong knowledge of Core PHP with OOPS.
  • Experience working with 3rd Party APIs
  • Experience working with MySQL/Maria DB
  • Experience with virtualization technologies like Vagrant/Docker
  • Debug, test, and fix errors
  • Experience with NoSQL  databases such as MongoDB is a plus


Document code development and revisions

  • Using GIT for version control/change management Additional office setting requirements:
  • Work well with a hard-working team
  • Preference for high-quality coffee


REQUIREMENTS:


  • Writing and understanding object-oriented PHP 
  • Experience with Laravel Framework starting from Version 6 onwards
  • Experience with ORM Experience with Cryptographic Library such as OpenSSH
  • Experience with SQL schema design
  • Ability to learn quickly and operate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Open-minded to new solutions, forward-thinking and strong ability to adapt
  • Git version control workflows
  • Proficiency in design patterns such as facade, repository, observer etc.
  • REST API design
  • Software testing (PHPUnit)
  • MySQL / MariaDB profiling and query optimization


At KoreInside, we offer you

  • Work with a diverse distributed team worldwide
  • Always-on learning and development
  • Collaborative work environment
  • All the tools and supports needed to do an excellent job
  • A dynamic workplace with a great balance of hard work and fun
  • A culture of innovation and a structure in which to innovate
  • A nurturing team-oriented environment with mentorship as a key feature of the dynamic

title: Corretor de imóveis
description:

title: Encarregado de solda
description:
Ter experiência comprovada em: habilidades de gestão de equipes de soldadores (pessoas), contratar soldadores, boa comunicação, Organização e planejamento dos serviços, vocabulário técnico em processos de soldagem, movido a desafios e busca continua da melhoria dos processos, de preferência ter a certificação de inspetor de solda, controlar e acompanhar os processos de preparação e soldagem, alto comprometimento com requisitos de segurança, ser facilitador para os soldadores,ter habilidades para treinar e desenvolver soldadores,

Planejar o processo de solda com antecedência quanto aos requisitos: Documentações (IEISs, EPSs, Desenhos, PIT e ou procedimentos de soldagem especificados em ordem de fabricação) consumíveis, máquinas e equipamentos.

Conhecer e Dominar as possíveis causas e soluções para Respingos abundantes, Soldas irregulares, Mordeduras laterais, Raízes defeituosas, Falta de Penetração, Soldas porosas, Inclusões de escória, Trincas,

Ter o domínio dos consumíveis, materiais, máquinas e suas respectivas regulagens.

Entender e fazer a equipe atender os parâmetros descritos nas IEIS e EPS.

Conhecer e conduzir a equipe de soldadores par a qualificação nas posições de soldagem 6G.

Ter o domínio e Qualificação nos processos GMAW (MIG-MAG, FCAW (arame tubular), GMAW - P (MIG-MAG pulsada), GTAW (TIG), GTAW - P (TIG pulsada), SMAW (Eletrodo revestido) e SAW (Arco submerso) .

Conhecer e atender Normas ASME IX, ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (vasos de Pressão) ASME 8, API STD 1104 (Standard for Welding Pipelines and Related Facilities, tubulações e dutos na área de Petróleo), AWS D 1.1, Estructural Welding Code (estruturas de aço carbono de baixa liga), Estar qualificado para atender as norma: ISSO, AWS, DIN, ABNT, etc.

Ter o domínio da definição de \"F-number\" (material de adição)

Ter o domínio da definição de \"P-number\" (material base).

Ter conhecimento e experiência em soldas que necessitem de ensaios volumétricos (Ultrassom e ou raio x).

Ter experiência e ter soldado aços liga: Ex. inconel 718, inconel 625, monel 400, monel 500K, P11, P22, P91 e P92 (conhecer os requisitos e as curvas ou Rampas de aquecimento e resfriamento).

  • Dominar e atender as VARIÁVEIS; Composição, classe e espessura do MB; Processos de soldagem; tipos de consumíveis e suas características; projeto de junta; posição de soldagem, temperatura de pré-aquecimento entre passes; correntes; tensão; velocidade de soldagem e aporte de calor.

description:
Orgulho de ser Camil!


Somos uma das maiores empresas de alimentos do Brasil, com presença na América Latina e exportações para mais de 60 países. Reunimos marcas icônicas como Camil, Coqueiro, União, Santa Amália, Mabel e Toddy, presentes na rotina de milhões de consumidores.

Venha construir uma carreira de sucesso!

title: SDR - Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
Remuneração Fixo + variável - PJ - Vaga Home Office


Estamos em busca de um SDR (Sales Development Representative) para integrar nossa equipe de forma remota, atuando no atendimento inicial de leads via WhatsApp e chamadas de vídeo. Se você tem habilidade em comunicação, é organizado e busca uma oportunidade com potencial de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a meritocracia, essa vaga é para você.


⚠️ É imprescindível ter experiência prévia como SDR.


Habilidades e Qualidades Necessárias:

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e empatia para entender as necessidades dos leads.
  • Disciplina e organização para gerenciar múltiplos atendimentos de forma eficiente.
  • Ambição e foco em resultados para alcançar e superar objetivos.
  • Capacidade de aprendizado rápido para assimilar os processos e ferramentas da empresa.
  • Resiliência e proatividade frente aos desafios.
  • Ser uma pessoa extremamente focada em resultados.
  • Experiência anterior como SDR é obrigatória.


Responsabilidades:

  • Receber e atender leads que chegam via WhatsApp de forma eficiente e acolhedora.
  • Coletar dados do lead, compreendendo suas necessidades e expectativas.
  • Realizar uma análise inicial para qualificar os leads de acordo com critérios estabelecidos.
  • Encaminhar os dados coletados e análises para o responsável, garantindo uma transição suave e eficaz.
  • Participar da conversa de Handoff com o closer.


Oferecemos:

  • Uma oportunidade de carreira em uma empresa em crescimento.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho meritocrático, onde seu resultado é reconhecido.
  • Treinamento e desenvolvimento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades.
  • Remuneração fixa + variável e bônus.

title: Merchant Onboarding Leader
description:
Job Responsibilities:

Business Process & Strategy Design:

  • Lead the design and optimization of SOPs for the entire merchant lifecycle, from signing to launch (qualification review – store decoration – menu entry – equipment debugging).
  • Establish a scalable and standardized operating system, collaborating deeply with product teams to digitize and streamline complex workflows.
  • Develop differentiated launch strategies and service standards, balancing speed, quality, and strategic platform requirements to support business growth.

Team Management & Delivery Assurance

  • Manage and inspire the Onboarding team (30+), overseeing daily operations (review, decoration, equipment operation, etc.).
  • Build and implement advanced human efficiency evaluation models, maximizing team output through scientific scheduling, task allocation, and targeted skills training.
  • Monitor and improve core efficiency, quality, and quantity indicators; proactively identify and resolve operational bottlenecks.
  • Establish robust internal mechanisms and inspection processes to ensure merchant compliance, accurate information, stable equipment connectivity, and exceptional launch quality.

Cost Control & Resource Integration

  • Analyze and optimize operational cost structures, achieving cost reduction targets through process integration and technology-driven efficiency improvements.
  • Integrate resources to enhance productivity and support sustainable business expansion


Job Requirements:

  • Proven track record and experience in internet operations and B2B delivery, including at least 2 years leading teams of 30+ people.
  • Candidates with experience building process systems from scratch will be prioritized.
  • Deep understanding of merchant operations, menu data structuring, API integration logic, and IT device principles (e.g., printers).
  • Strong data analysis skills, with proven ability to identify inefficiencies and drive impactful solutions.
  • Outstanding cross-functional collaboration skills, adept at leading joint initiatives across R&D, sales, and customer service to resolve bottlenecks and enable seamless operations.


Job Highlights:

  • Core Leadership Role: Serve as the key bridge between sales and fulfillment, directly shaping merchants’ online experience and driving business growth.
  • Strategic Career Path: Lead both operational strategy and team management, tackling complex and scalable business challenges with significant impact and visibility.
  • International Exposure: Play a vital role in building diverse markets and business scenarios, growing globally alongside Keeta, and unlocking broad career prospects.

title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS SAP TM
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade

  • Realizar o suporte as áreas de Supply chain, garantindo a correta execução de seus processos;
  • Fazer alinhamentos e governanças dos atendimentos de chamados com as áreas clientes e TI, buscando melhoras o suporte realizado as áreas de negócio;
  • Elaborar estudos de viabilidade técnica, bem como especificações funcionais e técnicas para soluções de tratativas de causa raiz para erros sistêmicos;
  • Acompanhar os status das demandas e realizar follow-up dos planos de ação, garantindo a execução dos testes pelas áreas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com nossos clientes para entender suas necessidades específicas e encontrar as melhores soluções dentro do módulo SAP TM.
  • Apoiar key users, conduzindo treinamentos e orientação funcional.


REQUISITOS

  • Graduação em TI, Ciências da Computação ou Análise de Sistemas;
  • Necessário:
  • Conhecimento em suporte ao módulo SAP TM (Transportation Management)
  • Experiência em suporte AMS no módulo TM nos processos de Planejamento de Fretes através do Sistema SAP TM;
  • Conhecimento aprofundado nos processos de Planejamento de transporte, Freight Order, Freight Agreement e Charge Calculation.
  • Diferencial:

title: Back End Developer
description:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) de Vendas Internas - Prospecção Ativa, com perfil focado, comunicativo, persistente e com sede por resultados, que queira aprender na prática e crescer junto com uma indústria do setor Alimentício em plena expansão.

Você fará parte de um time que atua com metas, prazos e negociações, participando diretamente do processo de vendas internas (telefone, WhatsApp e CRM), além de atividades operacionais ligadas à área comercial.

Este é o lugar certo para quem deseja se desenvolver comercialmente, com oportunidade real de crescimento, aprendendo a aplicar conceitos de funil de vendas, negociação, relacionamento com cliente e estratégias comerciais.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Realizar vendas ativas e receptivas via telefone/whatsapp. Atuação com Prospecção Ativa de novos clientes.
  • Abertura de novos cadastros e oportunidades comerciais
  • Vendas consultivas focadas em novos clientes.
  • Atualização e gestão constante do funil de vendas no CRM e controle de metas
  • Cumprimento rigoroso das metas de prospecção e faturamento
  • Apoiar no relacionamento com clientes em negociação e no pós-venda
  • Simular pedidos, consultar prazos e negociar condições comerciais
  • Criar e alimentar planilhas de acompanhamento comercial
  • Fazer lançamentos e consultas em sistema ERP
  • Atuação com alto volume de ligações e contatos, com foco em aumento de conversão e geração contínua de oportunidades comerciais.
  • Colaborador(a) estará desenvolvendo papel estratégico de crescimento de mercado para a Pure Seasoning.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino Médio Completo (obrigatório). Superior: diferencial
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar em horário comercial
  • Pacote Office Básico (Word/Excel)
  • Interesse na área comercial/vendas
  • Somente candidatos que moram em Lavras/MG - *requisito eliminatório


Diferencial Ensino Superior - Cursos Preferenciais (não eliminatórios)

  • Administração
  • Gestão Comercial
  • Marketing
  • Economia
  • Engenharia de Produção
  • Processos Gerenciais
  • Outros cursos com afinidade à área comercial


Competências e Habilidades Desejadas

  • Desenvoltura e boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Perfil comercial agressivo e orientado para metas
  • Persistência, consistência e resiliência diante de desafios
  • Organização, disciplina, proatividade e senso de urgência
  • Capacidade de negociação e argumentação
  • Conhecimento ou interesse em funil de vendas e processos comerciais
  • Raciocínio lógico e atenção a detalhes
  • Espírito de equipe e vontade de aprender rápido

Diferencial: Conhecimento intermediário em Excel (filtros, fórmulas, tabelas)


Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Remuneração fixa
  • Remuneração variável mensal conforme metas atingidas
  • Desconto em produtos da indústria
  • Café da manhã e café da tarde diários
  • Kit de produtos da empresa
  • Cozinha equipada disponível
  • Uniforme


Como Ter Sucesso Neste Cargo

Para se destacar nesta vaga, você precisa abraçar o desafio de vender todos os dias com atitude, foco e consistência.

O sucesso virá para quem tiver fome de resultado, comunicação afiada, disposição para aprender rápido, resiliência para lidar com “nãos” e capacidade de buscar soluções.

Aqui, valorizamos quem assume responsabilidades, corre atrás de suas metas, se envolve com os processos e pensa como dono do negócio.

Se você tem perfil competitivo, comprometido e quer crescer, este é o lugar certo para você!
